_readme: Known symbols for ES1's DBSIM.EXE (ES1DBSIM): confirmed address -> meaning mappings, applied to the ES1Recon Ghidra project by ES2ApplySymbolNames.java.
Addresses are offsets into the flat X-32 image (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/x32-executable.md#the-image).
Schema, confidence rules and run order: tools/ghidra_scripts/README.md, 'Known symbols'.
Entries are in address order. tools/scripts/es2_naming.py insert and edit keep it, and check that it holds.

entries.name: X32_AllocMemory
entries.description: (size), C convention: rounds size up to a multiple of 0x1000 and asks the extender for that much memory (INT 21h AX=350Ch). On carry it returns -1; otherwise it stores EDX at 00090024, raises the high-water mark 00090028 to the block's end when the end is above it, and returns the block's address. Mem_InitHeap takes the heap's block from it, and operator new and malloc fall back on it while the heap is off.

entries.name: __x386_coproc_init
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__x386_coproc_init`, from `x386.asm`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 86 bytes from here.

entries.name: Camera_IsMountedOn
entries.description: (camera, object) in stack order: 1 when the camera's int16 +0x36 is 2 and its +0x32 is the object, otherwise 0. ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) leaves such an object out of the frame's draw; Sim_StartMission (0005a9dc) sets its main camera's +0x36 to 2.

entries.name: Cam_AttachOrbit
entries.description: (camera, centre, object) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies the 6-byte orbit centre to +0x38, stores object at +0x32, zeroes the orbit angles +0x26/+0x28/+0x2a, the distance +0x22, the angle rates +0x2c/+0x2e/+0x30 and the zoom rate +0x24, and sets the mode +0x36 to 1. ES2's Cam_AttachOrbit (DBSIM 0040109c) without its lock test. One call found by es2_xref, from 0005923c.

entries.name: Cam_AttachEye
entries.description: (camera, eye, object) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies the 6-byte eye offset to +0x3e, stores object at +0x32 and sets the mode +0x36 to 2. ES2's Cam_AttachEye (DBSIM 0040111c) without its lock test.

entries.name: Cam_SetMode
entries.description: (camera, mode) in stack order, callee-cleaned: stores mode in +0x36 when it is 0, 1 or 2 and does nothing otherwise. ES2's Cam_SetMode (DBSIM 00401148), which also takes 3 and tests the lock.

entries.name: Cam_Update
entries.description: (camera), callee-cleaned: places the camera by its mode +0x36. Mode 0, free: pitch +0x0c += +0x2c, clamped to +-0x3000 with +0x2c zeroed, roll +0x0e += +0x2e, heading +0x10 += +0x30; position +0 = that view's BuildEulerRotationMatrixQ14 applied to (0, int16 +0x24, 0) plus the position, its z raised to 100. Mode 1, orbit: distance +0x22 = clamp(+0x22 + +0x24, 2500, 30000); +0x2a += +0x30, +0x26 += +0x2c (clamped to +-0x3000, +0x2c zeroed), +0x28 += +0x2e; view = (+0x26, +0x28, +0x2a + the object's int16 +0x0a); eye = the object's frame (Context_GetTransform of object +6) applied to the centre +0x38, plus the view's rotation of (0, -distance, 0). When the eye's z is under 100: with the zoom rate +0x24 under 1 it restores the position, view and orbit angles it started the call with and returns; otherwise the pitch becomes Math_AsinBam((centre z - 100) * 0x4000 / distance), in the view and in +0x26, and the eye is recomputed. Mode 2, attached: through the object's vtable (+2) slot +0x28 node, Transform_Concat with the frame, the eye +0x3e applied and Transform_RotationToEuler plus +0x44/+0x46/+0x48 as the view; with a null node the frame applied to +0x3e and the object's own euler triple +6. ES2's Cam_Update (DBSIM 004011a0), which keeps the chase ring and mode 3, tests terrain height plus 0x226 where this tests 100, and keeps position and view at +4 and +0x10. Sim_Main calls it each frame on the main camera 000b5b8a.

entries.name: Cam_ApproachRate
entries.description: (axis, rate) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Math_RateLimitedMoveToward(0xc0, Math_Q8Multiply(0x800, axis), rate). ES2's Cam_ApproachRate (DBSIM 00401c20).

entries.name: Cam_ApproachZoom
entries.description: (axis, rate) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Math_RateLimitedMoveToward(0x50, Math_Q8Multiply(0x400, axis), rate). ES2's Cam_ApproachZoom (DBSIM 00401c4c).

entries.name: Cam_Steer
entries.description: (camera, trigger, throttle, steer) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's Cam_Steer (DBSIM 00401c74) with no lock test. Mode 0: Cam_ApproachRate(-steer, +0x30); with trigger set Cam_ApproachZoom(-throttle, +0x24) and Cam_ApproachRate(0, +0x2c), otherwise Cam_ApproachZoom(0, +0x24) and Cam_ApproachRate(throttle, +0x2c). Mode 1: the same with steer for the heading rate and throttle for the zoom rate. Other modes: nothing. Two calls found by es2_xref, from 0005771c and 0005a0c0.

entries.name: RegisterSubsystemLoader
entries.description: (phase, function) in stack order, callee-cleaned: stores function and the int16 phase in the next 6-byte record at 000bbcb0, the record index being the int16 count at 0009011c, which it increments; Subsystem_RunPhase (00000af4) walks the records. Static initialisers call it, among them Weapons_RegisterSubsystem (0000d67c), 000081f8, 00004b80 and 00005e78 for Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48), Bullet_LoadResources (00007bb0), Base_LoadResources (000046ac) and Explosion_LoadResources (00005764) at phase 2. ES2's RegisterSubsystemLoader (DBSIM 00401d64).

entries.name: Subsystem_RunPhase
entries.description: (phase), callee-cleaned: calls, in order, each function of the 6-byte {function, int16 phase} records at 000bbcb0 (count int16 0009011c) whose phase matches. Sim_RenderFrame runs phase 5. ES2's Subsystem_RunPhase (DBSIM 00401d94).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00000af4, against ES2's Subsystem_RunPhase

entries.name: Heap_Init
entries.description: (heap, block, size), callee-cleaned: sets up the heap object over the block: +0 base, +4 the size as given, +8 the free list (the block, its next link zeroed), and +0xc (free bytes) and +0x10 (their low mark) the size rounded down to a multiple of 8, which also becomes the block's size. Tags the block FBLK at +8.

entries.name: Heap_IsBlock
entries.description: (heap, block header): 1 when the address lies from the heap's base to 0x10 bytes before its end and carries a block tag (FBLK at +8 or ABLK at +0), else 0.

entries.name: Heap_LargestFree
entries.description: (heap), callee-cleaned: the largest size on the heap's free list (+8) less the 8-byte header, reading the list's head without testing it for null. Arena_Push sizes its arena with it on the heap 000ae4ac. ES1GO's Heap_LargestFree (00001091); ES2's Memory_LargestFreeBlock (DBSIM 00476dd0) subtracts 0x6c and clamps at 0.

entries.name: Heap_Alloc
entries.description: (heap, trackLow, size), callee-cleaned: first-fit allocation. Returns 0 for size 0. Rounds size + 8 up to a multiple of 8 and walks the free list (+8): a block of exactly that size is unlinked; a block more than 0x10 bytes larger is split, the tail staying on the list tagged FBLK; a block larger by 0x10 or less is passed over. The block is tagged ABLK, its payload zero-filled, its size taken off the free bytes (+0xc), and with trackLow set the low mark (+0x10) lowered to the free bytes. Returns the payload (header + 8), or 0 when no block fits.

entries.name: Heap_Free
entries.description: (heap, payload), callee-cleaned: nothing for a null payload. Adds the block's size back to the free bytes (+0xc), tags it FBLK, inserts it into the free list (+8) in address order, and merges it with the free block before it and the one after it where they touch.

entries.name: Heap_Realloc
entries.description: (heap, size, payload), callee-cleaned: size 0 frees the block (Heap_Free) and returns 0. A smaller size gives the tail back in place: to the free block that follows when there is one, otherwise as a new block freed through Heap_Free when the tail exceeds 0x10 bytes, and by moving the data into a new block (Heap_Alloc, memmove, Heap_Free) when it does not. A larger size takes the difference from a following free block large enough for it, and otherwise moves the data. The block after it is checked with Heap_IsBlock and its predecessor on the free list found with Heap_FindPrevFree. Lowers the low mark (+0x10) to the free bytes. Returns the payload, moved or not, or 0 when a move cannot allocate.

entries.name: Heap_FindPrevFree
entries.description: (heap, block): the free block whose next link is the given block, walking the list from +8; 0 when the block heads the list or the walk ends without finding it.

entries.name: Mem_InitHeap
entries.description: (size): caps size at X32_LargestFreeBlock() - 25000, takes a block that large from X32_AllocMemory, asserting 'Memory alloc failed' (memory.cpp line 504, severity 5) through Assert_Report when it returns -1, makes it the heap 000ae4ac (Heap_Init) and sets 000901d4, which sends operator new, malloc and the frees to the heap. Returns the capped size.

entries.name: Mem_HeapOff
entries.description: Clears 000901d4, after which operator new and malloc take memory from X32_AllocMemory and the frees do nothing.

entries.name: operator_new
entries.description: The game's operator new (size), callee-cleaned (RET 4): Heap_Alloc(000ae4ac, 1, size) while 000901d4 is set, otherwise X32_AllocMemory(size) with -1 returned as 0. It is the allocation a constructor makes for a null this (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/compiler.md#constructors-and-destructors). malloc is the same body with the C convention.

entries.name: Mem_AllocFromHeap
entries.description: (heap, size), callee-cleaned (RET 8): Heap_Alloc(heap, 1, size) on the heap it is given.

entries.name: operator_delete
entries.description: The game's operator delete (pointer), callee-cleaned (RET 4): Heap_Free(000ae4ac, pointer) while 000901d4 is set, otherwise nothing. It is the release a destructor makes when bit 0 of its flags is set (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/compiler.md#constructors-and-destructors). free is the same body with the C convention.

entries.name: malloc
entries.description: The game's malloc (size), C convention: operator_new's body, returning with a plain RET. It is the _malloc of the startup's argument vector (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/compiler.md#startup).

entries.name: free
entries.description: The game's free (pointer), C convention: operator_delete's body, returning with a plain RET.

entries.name: realloc
entries.description: The game's realloc (pointer, size), C convention: Heap_Realloc(000ae4ac, size, pointer), whether or not 000901d4 is set.

entries.name: calloc
entries.description: The game's calloc (count, size), C convention: count * size bytes from Heap_Alloc(000ae4ac, 1, ...) while 000901d4 is set, otherwise from X32_AllocMemory with -1 returned as 0, then memset to zero over the block's size from the header at payload-4, less 8. A block from X32_AllocMemory has no header, so that size is read from the 4 bytes before it.

entries.name: Context_GetTransform
entries.description: (context), callee-cleaned: the rotation an object's orientation block holds, built on demand. When the word at +0x26 is 0 it builds the Q14 rotation at +6 from the three int16 Euler angles at +0 with BuildEulerRotationMatrixQ14 (0005f0ac) and sets the word to 1; it returns context + 6. Most of the calls es2_naming.py callers lists pass an object's +6. ES2's class 'Context' (0x28 bytes, no vptr; MAT_OBJ's base at +0xc) has this layout, and ES2's SimObject_InstallModelTransform (DBSIM 00401fe4) builds the matrix inline.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 000016e8, against ES2's SimObject_InstallModelTransform

entries.name: SimObject_InstallModelTransform
entries.description: (object), callee-cleaned: installs an object's orientation as the renderer's model transform: Raster_SetModelTransform(Context_GetTransform(object + 6)), Context_GetTransform building the rotation on demand. es2_xref finds 16 calls and 10 stored pointers (draw slots of object vtables). ES2's SimObject_InstallModelTransform (DBSIM 00401fe4) builds the matrix inline.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile and disassembly at 00001854, against ES2's SimObject_InstallModelTransform

entries.name: TSObj_ReturnZero
entries.description: (object), callee-cleaned (RET 4), frameless: returns 0. Slot +0x10 of TS_OBJ's vtable 000902ea, MAT_OBJ's 000902ca and three others.

entries.name: TSObj_Ctor
entries.description: (object, shape) in stack order, callee-cleaned: TS_OBJ's constructor, allocating 0x3b bytes when object is null. Installs DRAWABLE's vtable 0009020a at +2, zeroes the Context at +6 (its Euler angles at +0, its translation at +0x1a and its cached-rotation word +0x26), installs MAT_OBJ's vtable 000902ca and then TS_OBJ's 000902ea, stores TSShapeInstance_Ctor(0, shape) at +0x2e (0 for a null shape) and clears the 8 bytes at +0x32. ES2's TS_OBJ is 0x41 bytes with the shape instance at +0x34.

entries.name: MatObj_GetPosition
entries.description: (object): returns object + 0x20, the translation of the orientation block at +6. Slot +8 of MAT_OBJ's vtable 000902ca.

entries.name: TSObj_Render
entries.description: (object): TS_OBJ's draw, slot +4 of its vtable 000902ea: SimObject_InstallModelTransform (00001854)(object), then slot +0x20 of the shape instance at +0x2e. TSObj_RenderCopy (00020550) is the same code.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00001cdc; es2_naming diff against 00020550, identical

entries.name: TSObj_GetPosition
entries.description: (object): returns object + 0x20, the translation of the orientation block at +6. Slot +8 of TS_OBJ's vtable 000902ea.

entries.name: TSObj_GetRadius
entries.description: (object): the int16 at +8 of the shape (+4) of the shape instance at +0x2e, sign-extended; 0 when there is no instance or no shape. Slot +0x14 of TS_OBJ's vtable 000902ea, the radius WorldShades_DistanceBand and ObjList_DrawFrameObjects read.

entries.name: ShapeInstance_CtorCellFrames
entries.description: (holder, shape) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the two-field shape-instance holder's constructor, allocating 8 bytes when holder is null. Stores the shape at +0 and, when the shape's word count +0x24 is non-zero, a copy of its word array +0x1c (Arena_Alloc from the arena 000bd954, then memmove) at +4, else 0. HeapBlockOwner_Dtor is its destructor. ES2's ShapeInstance_CtorCellFrames (DBSIM 00402fc0).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0000252c, against ES2's ShapeInstance_CtorCellFrames

entries.name: HeapBlockOwner_Dtor
entries.description: (owner, flags), callee-cleaned: operator_delete of the block at owner + 4, then of owner itself when flags bit 0 is set; returns at once for a null owner. The destructor of the holder ShapeInstance_CtorCellFrames builds: destructors such as 00000338 (which ends in TSBase_Dtor) and 000028e0 run it on the holder at their +0x10 with flags 0. ES2's HeapBlockOwner_Dtor (DBSIM 00403020).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00002598, against ES2's HeapBlockOwner_Dtor

entries.name: MechType_BindHardpointSlots
entries.description: (slotList, boneIds, count, root) in stack order, callee-cleaned: stores count at slotList+4 and a new array of count pointers at slotList+0, then for each bone id stores the root's vtable +0x28 answer for it, or null for a negative id. ES2's MechType_BindHardpointSlots (DBSIM 0040304c), whose arguments are (slotList, root, count, boneIds) and whose find goes through vtable +0x24.

entries.name: ConfigPart_Render
entries.description: (part), callee-cleaned: with a shape at +0x10, saves 000bd912 and 000bdb5e, stores the shape's +0x26 in 000bdb5e, calls 00052890(part, a local frame), stores the part's +0x14 in 000bd912, calls 00052e18(shape), restores both globals and calls 0005298c(part, the local frame); with none it returns. Slot +0x20 of ConfigPart's tables. ES2's ConfigPart_Render (DBSIM 0040316c), which calls TSGroup_BindNodeTransform, TSPartList_Render and Render_NoOp in those places.

entries.name: BaseFormation_GetSlotOffset
entries.description: (object, slot, formation) in stack order, callee-cleaned, object unread: copies the two int32 at 000bc190 + formation * 0x38 + slot * 8 - 8 (BFORMS.DAT's 56-byte formations of seven (x, y) slots) to the static point 000aee08 and returns it, its z 000aee10 set to 0 on the first call (flag 000aee06). Neither number is checked. ES2's BaseFormation_GetSlotOffset (DBSIM 00405b9c), which reads 10-byte slots through a per-formation pointer.

entries.name: Base_ApplyFormationOffset
entries.description: (object, position) in stack order, callee-cleaned: nothing when the object's int16 member slot +0x43 is 0; otherwise Formation_RotateAndAddOffset (0000d9a0)(object, position, BaseFormation_GetSlotOffset (0000441c)(object, slot, the formation number at +2 of the group the object's +0x3f points at)). ES2's Base_ApplyFormationOffset (DBSIM 00405c04). Caller found by es2_xref: 000044a4.

entries.name: Base_LoadResources
entries.description: No arguments: reads dat\bforms (severity-5 assert, base.cpp line 0x270, when the stream status is set), an int16 count to 000bc18e and that many 0x38-byte records into a __vec_new array at 000bc190; opens dat\bases (line 0x27b), reads its int16 count to 000bc188, builds that many 0x3e-byte records at g_BaseTypeTable (000bc18a) and count * 6 bytes at 000bc194, and reads 0x36 bytes into each record, setting its +0x3a to the type's 6-byte slot at 000bc194 when +0x06 is non-zero and to 0 when not; opens dat\basecol (line 0x296) and calls Collision_LoadRecordArray (000094f0)(slot, stream) for every type; keeps the greatest +0x02 plus one of the types with +0x06 zero at 000bc174 and of the others at 000bc16a, and the greatest +0x04 plus one at 000bc17e; loads dgs\bhulks with Shape_LoadAllRoots (tag 0x2bc0001) into 000bc180; allocates zeroed pointer arrays of 000bc174 entries at 000bc176 and 000bc17a and of 000bc16a entries at 000bc16c and 000bc170; and when g_LowMemory (000bda98) is 0 loads dba\basetex into 000bc184. A phase-2 loader. ES2's Base_LoadResources (DBSIM 00405fac), which also reads dat\lc_wpns and reads BASES.DAT field by field with its component arrays.

entries.name: LightManager_Construct
entries.description: (manager), callee-cleaned: ES2's LightManager_Construct (DBSIM 00406e44). Allocates 0x404 bytes for a null manager; __vec_ctor of twenty 0x23-byte slots at +0x6c (element constructor at the padding entry 00004ce5); the embedded light at +0x328 built as a TSLight (vtable 00090766 at +0x12) and retyped TSAmbientLight (0009077a), type 0 at +0x16; zeroes the live count +0x18 and the free-list counts +0x35c and +0x3b0; LightManager_SetFalloffConstants with 3000 and 2000 in stack order; then marks each slot free (+0) with a null light (+0x1f).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00004bb8, against ES2's LightManager_Construct

entries.name: TSLight_DtorCopy
entries.description: (light, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +4 of the light manager module's TSLight vtable 00090766: stores that vtable, TSContext_Dtor(light + 0x1e, 2) and TSContext_Dtor(light, 0), and operator_delete when flags bit 0 is set; nothing for a null light. The same code as TSLight_Dtor (0005a964) for the module's own vtable copy.

entries.name: TSAmbientLight_Dtor
entries.description: (light, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +4 of TSAmbientLight's vtable 0009077a: stores that vtable and then TSLight's 00090766, TSContext_Dtor(light + 0x1e, 2) and TSContext_Dtor(light, 0), and operator_delete when flags bit 0 is set. ES2's TSAmbientLight_Dtor (DBSIM 0040798c).

entries.name: LightManager_SetFalloffConstants
entries.description: (manager, b, a) in stack order, callee-cleaned: stores a >> 5 at +0x10 (A) and b >> 5 at +0x14 (B). LightManager_InitSubsystem passes 2000 and 10, so A = 0 and B = 62 as in ES2's LightManager_SetFalloffConstants (DBSIM 00406ee4).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00004da8 and the push order at 000055c6

entries.name: LightManager_SetSlotFalloff
entries.description: (manager, b, a, slot) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the slot's A (+0xf) = a >> 5 and B (+0x13) = b >> 5, slot = manager + 0x6c + index * 0x23, then LightManager_RecomputeCullRadius. ES2's LightManager_SetSlotFalloff (DBSIM 00406f00). es2_xref finds its address only as the dword at 0002116c.

entries.name: LightManager_ClaimSlot
entries.description: (manager, point), callee-cleaned: ES2's LightManager_ClaimSlot (DBSIM 00406f38): takes the first free slot of twenty, clears its free flag, copies the point to +1, seeds the int16 intensity +0xd with 0xff, copies the manager's A and B to +0xf and +0x13, appends the slot to the live array +0x1c and recomputes its cull radius; returns the index. With every slot busy it writes through an uninitialised local.

entries.name: LightManager_ReleaseSlot
entries.description: (manager, slot index), callee-cleaned: ES2's LightManager_ReleaseSlot (DBSIM 00406fbc): sets the slot's free flag, moves the live array's last entry over it, recycles its light (+0x1f) with LightManager_RecycleLight and nulls it.

entries.name: LightManager_SetSlotPosition
entries.description: (manager, point, slot index) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies the int32 triple to the slot's +1. ES2's LightManager_SetSlotPosition (DBSIM 00407018).

entries.name: LightManager_SetSlotIntensity
entries.description: (manager, intensity, slot index) in stack order, callee-cleaned: stores the int16 at the slot's +0xd and, sign-extended, at +0x1b, and recomputes the cull radius. ES2's LightManager_SetSlotIntensity (DBSIM 00407048).

entries.name: LightManager_SetCameraPosition
entries.description: (manager, camera), callee-cleaned: copies the camera's position (+0, three int32) to the manager's +0. es2_xref finds its caller ObjList_DrawFrameObjects, which runs each frame, where ES2's LightManager_SetCameraPosition (DBSIM 0040707c) is called from Sim_RenderFrame.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00004f60 and its call at 0002101a

entries.name: LightManager_SelectLightsForObject
entries.description: (manager, {x, y, z, radius} as four int32), callee-cleaned: ES2's LightManager_SelectLightsForObject (DBSIM 00407098). Unregisters the embedded light +0x328; for each live slot with a non-zero +0x1b: past the cull radius +0x17 it recycles the slot's light; otherwise, d = distance >> 5 (Point3I_DistanceBetween), when d is not 0 and Math_Atan2Guarded(x d, y radius >> 5) is below 8000 a directional light (Light_GetOrCreateDirectional) with intensity +0x1b * min(0xff, (B << 8) / (d + A)) >> 8 and direction (object - slot) * 0x800 / distance at +0xc, else a point light (Light_GetOrCreatePoint) with intensity +0x1b, +0x34 = A << 5, +0x38 = B * 0x20, +0x3c = +0x38 * intensity and the slot's position at +0. es2_xref finds its caller ObjList_DrawEntryRender, which calls it before each object's draw.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00004f78, diff against ES2's LightManager_SelectLightsForObject

entries.name: LightManager_RecomputeCullRadius
entries.description: (manager, slot), callee-cleaned: slot +0x17 = (B * 0x20 * the int16 intensity +0xd) / 10 + A * 0x20. ES2's LightManager_RecomputeCullRadius (DBSIM 0040735c).

entries.name: Light_GetOrCreateDirectional
entries.description: (manager), callee-cleaned: pops a light from the free list +0x35c/+0x360, or allocates a 0x34-byte TSLight retyped TSSunLight (vtable 0009078e at +0x12, type 1 at +0x16), and registers it with Light_Register; returns it. ES2's Light_GetOrCreateDirectional (DBSIM 00407388).

entries.name: TSSunLight_DtorCopy
entries.description: (light, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +4 of the light manager module's TSSunLight vtable 0009078e: stores that vtable and then TSLight's 00090766, TSContext_Dtor(light + 0x1e, 2) and TSContext_Dtor(light, 0), and operator_delete when flags bit 0 is set. The same code as TSSunLight_Dtor (0005a99c) for the module's own vtable copies.

entries.name: Light_GetOrCreatePoint
entries.description: (manager), callee-cleaned: pops a light from the free list +0x3b0/+0x3b4, or allocates a 0x40-byte TSLight retyped TSOmniLight (vtable 000907a2 at +0x12, type 2 at +0x16), and registers it with Light_Register; returns it. ES2's Light_GetOrCreatePoint (DBSIM 00407444).

entries.name: TSOmniLight_Dtor
entries.description: (light, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +4 of TSOmniLight's vtable 000907a2: stores that vtable and then TSLight's 00090766, TSContext_Dtor(light + 0x1e, 2) and TSContext_Dtor(light, 0), and operator_delete when flags bit 0 is set. ES2's TSOmniLight_Dtor (DBSIM 004075c1).

entries.name: LightManager_RecycleLight
entries.description: (manager, light), callee-cleaned: for a non-null light, Light_Unregister and a push onto the directional free list (+0x35c/+0x360) when its type +0x16 is 1, the point list (+0x3b0/+0x3b4) otherwise. ES2's LightManager_RecycleLight (DBSIM 00407500).

entries.name: EffectLight_Construct
entries.description: (handle, intensity, point) in stack order, callee-cleaned: takes a handle from the pool 000aee18 for a null one (returns 0 when it is empty), stores the vptrs 000907b6 and 000907d6 at +2, claims a manager slot at the point (LightManager_ClaimSlot) into the int16 +6 and sets its intensity (LightManager_SetSlotIntensity). Explosion_Construct passes the type row's dword at +0x0c. ES2's EffectLight_Construct (DBSIM 00407604), whose handle is 0xe bytes.

entries.name: WeaponMount_CtorAmmunition
entries.description: (mount, owner, projectile record, template, hardpoint record, machine) in stack order, callee-cleaned: allocates 0x81 bytes when given no mount and returns 0 when that fails; runs WeaponMount_CtorBase (0000a530)(mount, projectile record, template, hardpoint record, machine), never reading its second argument; stores AmmunitionMountVtableMountsCopy (0009102a), copies the template's int16 +0x3a to +0x7b and, shifted left 8, to the dword +0x7d, and clears the dword +0x77. Returns the mount. ES2's WeaponMount_CtorAmmunition (DBSIM 0040e140).

entries.name: WeaponMount_DtorAmmunitionMountsCopy
entries.description: (mount, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of the vtable AmmunitionMountVtableMountsCopy (0009102a) (entered at its padding 0000aa39): byte for byte the code of WeaponMount_DtorAmmunition (0000c7bc), relocated operands aside, storing AmmunitionMountVtableMountsCopy (0009102a) and WeaponMountBaseVtableMountsCopy (00090f42) and 00090f0e and 00090eda where that stores 00091516 and 000914a2 and 00091142 and 00091176. ES2's WeaponMount_DtorAmmunition (DBSIM 004115a5).

entries.name: WeaponMount_DrainAmmoMountsCopy
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: slot +0x50 of the vtable AmmunitionMountVtableMountsCopy (0009102a) (entered at its padding 0000aa87): byte for byte the code of WeaponMount_DrainAmmo (0000c708), relocated operands aside. ES2's WeaponMount_DrainAmmo (DBSIM 004115f8).

entries.name: WeaponMount_GetDisplayName
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: with no projectile record at +0x20 or one whose int16 +0 is not 0, copies the template's (+0x1c) name +0x52 into WeaponMount_DisplayNameBuffer (000af1dc); for a rocket record (+0 = 0), copies MissileAmmoNameTable (000910ac)[the record's int16 +2] there and appends the template's name with strcat. Returns the buffer. ES2's WeaponMount_GetDisplayName (DBSIM 0040e18c), which copies the subtype's name alone. es2_xref.py finds calls from WeaponMount_CreateEnergyGauge (0000a97c), WeaponMount_CreateAmmoGauge (0000ab20) and 00042751.

entries.name: WeaponMount_CreateAmmoGauge
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: the gauge-factory slot +0x68 of the ammunition and grenade vtables: CockpitView_CreateAmmoWeaponGauge(CockpitViewInstance, mount, WeaponMount_GetDisplayName (0000aa9c)(mount), the signed byte +7 of the hardpoint record at +0x18) into +0x77. ES2's WeaponMount_CreateAmmoGauge (DBSIM 0040e20c), whose factory takes no name.

entries.name: EcmMount_Ctor
entries.description: (mount, owner, template, hardpoint record, machine) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the ECM's constructor. Allocates 0x7f bytes when given no mount and returns 0 when that fails; runs WeaponMount_CtorBase (0000a530)(mount, 0, template, hardpoint record, machine), never reading its second argument; stores EcmMountVtable (000910be), clears the int16 +0x7d (twice), the dword +0x77 and the selectable byte +0x4c. Returns the mount. ES2's EcmPod_Ctor (DBSIM 0040e274), which runs Pod_CtorBase and keeps a catalog id at +0x77 and the gauge at +0x79.

entries.name: EcmMount_Dtor
entries.description: (mount, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of EcmMountVtable (000910be): the code of WeaponMount_DtorAmmunition (0000c7bc), relocated operands aside. Returns at once for a null mount; otherwise stores EcmMountVtable, WeaponMountBaseVtableMountsCopy (00090f42) and 00090f0e in turn, runs HeapBlockOwner_Dtor (00002598)(mount + 0x10, 0), stores 00090eda, runs TSBase_Dtor (0005ba58)(mount, 0) and calls operator_delete (000015f8) when flags bit 0 is set. ES2's EcmPod_Dtor (DBSIM 00411450).

entries.name: EcmMount_CreateGauge
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: the ECM's gauge-factory slot +0x68: CockpitView_CreatePodGauge(CockpitViewInstance, mount, the signed byte +7 of the hardpoint record at +0x18) into +0x77. ES2's EcmPod_CreateGauge (DBSIM 0040e3bc), which keeps the gauge at +0x79.

entries.name: WeaponMount_RangeAllows
entries.description: (mount, range) in stack order, callee-cleaned: 1 when the int32 +0x2c of the template at the mount's +0x1c is below range and range is below the template's int32 +0x30, both bounds exclusive, otherwise 0. ES2's WeaponMount_RangeAllows (DBSIM 0040e5f8).

entries.name: WeaponMount_HardpointBoneId
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: returns the int16 +0 of the hardpoint record at +0x18, the hardpoint's bone. ES2's WeaponMount_HardpointBoneId (DBSIM 0040e61c). es2_xref.py finds one call, from 00012c00.

entries.name: WeaponMount_GetEnergyAmmoType
entries.description: (mount, out) in stack order, callee-cleaned: writes the int16 0 through out when it is not null and returns 5. The ammunition-subtype slot +0x64 of the base, energy, ELF and ECM vtables. ES2's WeaponMount_GetEnergyAmmoType (DBSIM 0040e62c), slot +0x60.

entries.name: WeaponMount_GetAmmoType
entries.description: (mount, out) in stack order, callee-cleaned: when the int16 +0 of the projectile record at +0x20 is 0, a rocket, writes the rounds +0x7b through out when it is not null and returns the record's int16 +2; otherwise returns WeaponMount_GetEnergyAmmoType (0000ac54)(mount, out). Slot +0x64 of the ammunition and grenade vtables. ES2's WeaponMount_GetAmmoType (DBSIM 0040e644), slot +0x60.

entries.name: EcmMount_TriggerHeldNever
entries.description: Frameless: a NOP, then XOR EAX,EAX and RET 8: returns 0 and removes two arguments. The trigger slot +0x34 of EcmMountVtable (000910be). ES2's Pod_TriggerHeldNever (DBSIM 0040e678), slot +0x30.

entries.name: ElfMount_TriggerHeld
entries.description: (mount, input) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the ELF's trigger slot +0x34. With the latch +0x48 clear it returns 0: a press (input byte +0x15) with +0x47 clear sets +0x47 and zeroes the int16 +0x80, and with no press a set +0x47 is cleared and the cell index at *(+0x14) set to 0. With +0x48 set it returns the input byte, and a release zeroes the cell index and clears +0x48. ES2's ElfMount_TriggerHeld (DBSIM 0040e680) on its input byte +0x0d and timer +0x84, without ES2's ELF2 branch and its test for a model at +0x10.

entries.name: GrenadeMount_TriggerHeld
entries.description: (mount, input) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the grenade's trigger slot +0x34, a hold-to-throw. With +0x46 clear, a press (input byte +0x15) sets +0x46 and the dword +0x81 to 20000, and it returns 0. With +0x46 set, while pressed it adds 1000 to +0x81 and returns 0 until that passes 100000; then, or on a release, it returns 1, calling 0004d8c8(1, 1) when still pressed. ES2's GrenadeMount_TriggerHeld (DBSIM 0040e71c), which reads +0x0d and calls Input_LatchButton.

entries.name: WeaponMount_PrepareShot
entries.description: (mount, free-shot flag, machine) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the base fire slot +0x2c and the prologue of every fire dispatch; it never reads its second argument. Looks up the node of the hardpoint's bone (int16 +0 of the record at +0x18) through slot +0x24 of the object at +4 of the machine's +0x2e, taking the 0x20-byte frame the answer's int16 +4 indexes in the +0x16 array of the machine's +0x2e, or a null pointer with no answer; when +0x5f or +0x5b is 0 it builds BuildEulerRotationMatrixQ14 of (+0x24 when +0x5b is 0, 0, +0x28 when +0x5f is 0) and composes it with the frame through 000647f4. Transform_Concat of the frame and Context_GetTransform(machine + 6) goes to WeaponMount_ShotTransform (000af144); the template's +0x40 triple plus WeaponMount_MuzzleOffset (0000b918)(mount) goes through Transform_ApplyToShortPoint to WeaponMount_ShotMuzzlePoint (000af164), and Transform_RotationToEuler of the transform to WeaponMount_ShotEuler (000af170). Sets the refire countdown +0x31 to the template's +0x4c and byte 0 of +0x33 and +0x3b to 1. ES2's WeaponMount_PrepareShot (DBSIM 0040e788), which scales the refire by +0x63, substitutes a fixed transform for a missing node, builds the machine's transform from its angles and swaps in the spectator's watched object.

entries.name: EcmMount_FireNoOp
entries.description: Frameless: RET 0xc, removing three arguments. The fire slot +0x2c of EcmMountVtable (000910be). ES2's Pod_FireNoOp (DBSIM 0040e95c), slot +0x28.

entries.name: WeaponMount_FireDispatch_Missile
entries.description: (mount, free-shot flag, machine) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the ammunition fire slot +0x2c. WeaponMount_PrepareShot (0000add4) with its arguments; when the flag is 0, subtracts the template's int16 +0x38 from the rounds +0x7b and at 0 or below clears them and the selectable byte +0x4c. For a projectile record (+0x20) of int16 type 0 it calls 00007748(0, machine, WeaponMount_ShotEuler (000af170), WeaponMount_ShotMuzzlePoint (000af164), the record's +2); otherwise 00008134(machine, the angles, the muzzle point, the record's +2), then sets +0x44 when the hardpoint's byte +6 is below 4. ES2's WeaponMount_FireDispatch_Missile (DBSIM 0040e964), which calls Rocket_Fire and Bullet_Fire there.

entries.name: GrenadeMount_FireDispatch
entries.description: (mount, free-shot flag, machine) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the grenade's fire slot +0x2c. WeaponMount_PrepareShot (0000add4) with its arguments; when the flag is 0, takes one off the rounds +0x7b; clears +0x46; calls 00007b44(the dword +0x81, machine, WeaponMount_ShotEuler (000af170), WeaponMount_ShotMuzzlePoint (000af164), the projectile record's +2). ES2's GrenadeMount_FireDispatch (DBSIM 0040ea04), which passes the same to the empty Grenade_FireNoOp.

entries.name: WeaponMount_FireDispatch_GunBeam
entries.description: (mount, free-shot flag, machine) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the energy fire slot +0x2c. WeaponMount_PrepareShot (0000add4) with its arguments, +0x44 set when the hardpoint's byte +6 is below 4. For a record of type 4 it copies WeaponMount_ShotMuzzlePoint (000af164) into the shot transform's translation (000af158), takes min(the template's +0x38, the capacitor +0x7d) as the power, calls 000088cc(power, machine, the template's int32 +0x30, WeaponMount_ShotTransform (000af144), the record's +2) and takes the power off +0x7d. Otherwise, with +0x7d below the cost +0x38, 000081d4(the charge, machine, the angles, the muzzle point, the record's +2), and when the template's +0x3c is 3 two more at the muzzle offset with x = 0 and x = -(the template's +0x40); then +0x7d = 0. With +0x7d at or above the cost, subtracts the cost and calls 00008134(machine, the angles, the muzzle point, the record's +2). ES2's WeaponMount_FireDispatch_GunBeam (DBSIM 0040ea58), less its EMP2 second volley (+0x4d).

entries.name: ElfMount_FireDispatch
entries.description: (mount, free-shot flag, machine) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the ELF's fire slot +0x2c. WeaponMount_PrepareShot (0000add4) with its arguments, the template's +0x38 taken off the capacitor +0x7d unconditionally, WeaponMount_ShotMuzzlePoint (000af164) copied into the shot transform's translation, and 000088cc(0x4b0, machine, the template's int32 +0x30, WeaponMount_ShotTransform (000af144), the record's +2). ES2's ElfMount_FireDispatch (DBSIM 0040ec64).

entries.name: EcmMount_CanFireNever
entries.description: Frameless: XOR EAX,EAX and RET 4: returns 0 and removes one argument. The ready slot +0x30 of EcmMountVtable (000910be). ES2's Pod_CanFireNever (DBSIM 0040ecd4), slot +0x2c.

entries.name: WeaponMount_EnergyCanFire
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: the energy ready slot +0x30. The threshold is max(the template's +0x36, +0x7b) when +0x36 is below the template's +0x38, otherwise +0x38; returns 1 when the mount is not destroyed (+0x49), the refire countdown +0x31 is 0 and the capacitor +0x7d is at least the threshold, otherwise 0. ES2's WeaponMount_EnergyCanFire (DBSIM 0040ecdc).

entries.name: WeaponMount_EnergyIsSpent
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: the energy and ELF spent slot +0x60: returns the destroyed byte +0x49, sign-extended. ES2's WeaponMount_EnergyIsSpent (DBSIM 0040ed34), slot +0x5c.

entries.name: WeaponMount_AmmoIsSpent
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: the ammunition and grenade spent slot +0x60: 1 when the rounds +0x7b are 0 or the mount is destroyed (+0x49), otherwise 0. ES2's WeaponMount_AmmoIsSpent (DBSIM 0040ed48), slot +0x5c.

entries.name: WeaponMount_AmmoCanFire
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: the ammunition and grenade ready slot +0x30: 1 when the mount is not destroyed (+0x49), the refire countdown +0x31 is 0 and the rounds +0x7b are not 0, otherwise 0. ES2's WeaponMount_AmmoCanFire (DBSIM 0040ed6c).

entries.name: ElfMount_CanFire
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: the ELF's ready slot +0x30: 1 when the mount is not destroyed (+0x49) and the capacitor +0x7d is at least max(the template's +0x36, +0x7b), or +0x33 is set and +0x7d is at least the template's +0x38; otherwise 0. ES2's ElfMount_CanFire (DBSIM 0040eda0).

entries.name: WeaponMount_RefireTick
entries.description: (mount, mid-charge seen, budget) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the pool-turn slot +0x38 of the base, ammunition, grenade and ECM vtables. Unless the mount is destroyed (+0x49): WeaponMount_AndFlagBlocks (0000b4a8)(mount + 0x33, mount + 0x3b), 8 bytes at +0x3b cleared, Math_CountdownTimerTick(mount + 0x30) on the countdown +0x31, and with +0x44 set the cell index at *(+0x14) stepped modulo the model's (+0x10) sequence count *(+0x20), clearing +0x44 when it wraps to 0. Returns the budget in AX. ES2's WeaponMount_RefireTick (DBSIM 0040ef94), slot +0x34.

entries.name: WeaponMount_AndFlagBlocks
entries.description: (dst, src) in stack order, callee-cleaned: dst[i] &= src[i] for 8 bytes. es2_xref.py finds one call, from WeaponMount_RefireTick (0000b408), through its padding entry 0000b4a5. ES2's WeaponMount_AndFlagBlocks (DBSIM 0040f881).

entries.name: WeaponMount_ChargeCapacitor
entries.description: (mount, mid-charge seen, budget) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the energy pool-turn slot +0x38. Unless the mount is destroyed (+0x49): WeaponMount_RefireTick (0000b408) with its arguments; the deficit is the charge target +0x7b (0 when the second argument is non-zero) less the capacitor +0x7d. A deficit of 0 or less clears +0x43 and gives back max(deficit, -5); otherwise it takes min(20, or 60 while +0x43 is set, budget, deficit). Adds the amount to +0x7d and returns the budget less it in AX; a destroyed mount returns the budget. ES2's WeaponMount_ChargeCapacitor (DBSIM 0040f00c), which draws its charge rate +0x7f and halves PLAS's draw.

entries.name: EcmMount_PushGaugeState
entries.description: (mount, armed, in the chain, ready) in stack order, callee-cleaned, RET 0x10: the ECM's gauge-push slot +0x54. Reads only the mount: copies the low byte of the first word of the block 00037b50(the gauge +0x77) returns into the int16 +0x7b and +0x7d. ES2's EcmPod_Tick (DBSIM 0040f184) posts a jamming message when that byte changes and writes the block back; this posts nothing and writes nothing back.

entries.name: WeaponMount_PushEnergyGaugeState
entries.description: (mount, b16, b15, b14) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the energy and ELF gauge-push slot +0x54. Copies the block EnergyWeaponGauge_GetState(+0x77) returns; with +0x34 clear the block's dword +4 comes back as the charge target, +0x7b = dword * 1200 >> 10, and with it set +0x7b goes out as (+0x7b << 10) / 1200; dword +0 = (+0x7d << 10) / 1200, byte +0x11 the destroyed byte +0x49, +0x12 the mid-charge byte +0x43, and +0x14, +0x15 and +0x16 its fourth, third and second arguments; then the gauge's slot +0x14 through the vptr at its +0x76. ES2's WeaponMount_PushEnergyGaugeState (DBSIM 0040f288), slot +0x50.

entries.name: WeaponMount_PushAmmoGaugeState
entries.description: (mount, b16, b15, b14) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the ammunition gauge-push slot +0x54. Copies the block AmmoWeaponGauge_GetState(+0x77) returns; moves the dword +0x7d down by Math_IntegrateRateOverTick(250) while above the rounds +0x7b × 256, and up to it when below; block dword +0 = +0x7d >> 8, byte +0x11 the destroyed byte +0x49, +0x14, +0x15 and +0x16 its fourth, third and second arguments; then the gauge's slot +0x14 through the vptr at its +0x76. ES2's WeaponMount_PushAmmoGaugeState (DBSIM 0040f330), slot +0x50.

entries.name: GrenadeMount_PushGaugeState
entries.description: (mount, b16, b15, b14) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the grenade's gauge-push slot +0x54: WeaponMount_PushAmmoGaugeState (0000b67c) with its arguments, then Mono_Printf(0x2a, 0x17, 'grenade dist: %ld' (0009112e), the dword +0x81). ES2's GrenadeMount_PushGaugeState (DBSIM 0040f3b8), which only forwards.

entries.name: ElfMount_SpinUpAndChargeTick
entries.description: (mount, mid-charge seen, budget) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the ELF's pool-turn slot +0x38. Unless the mount is destroyed (+0x49): with the spin-up byte +0x47 set, Math_CountdownTimerTick(mount + 0x7f) on the timer +0x80; when it reaches 0, at the model's (+0x10) last cell (*(+0x20) - 1) it sets +0x48 and clears +0x47, otherwise steps the cell index at *(+0x14) and zeroes +0x80. Then returns WeaponMount_ChargeCapacitor (0000b4d4) with its arguments; a destroyed mount returns the budget. ES2's ElfMount_SpinUpAndChargeTick (DBSIM 0040f3d8), with its timer at +0x84 and a test for a model and an empty sequence list.

entries.name: WeaponMount_AdjustPowerLevel
entries.description: (mount, up) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the energy power-level slot +0x3c: adds 0x50, or -0x50 when up is 0, to the charge target +0x7b, clamps it to 0..0x4b0 and sets +0x34 and +0x3c to 1. ES2's WeaponMount_AdjustPowerLevel (DBSIM 0040f48c), slot +0x38.

entries.name: WeaponMount_WakeCapacitor
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: the energy wake slot +0x40: sets the charge target +0x7b to 0x334 unless the mount is destroyed (+0x49). ES2's WeaponMount_WakeCapacitor (DBSIM 0040f4d8), slot +0x3c.

entries.name: WeaponMount_DemandFullCharge
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: the energy full-charge slot +0x44: sets the mid-charge byte +0x43 to 1 and the charge target +0x7b to 0x4b0. ES2's WeaponMount_DemandFullCharge (DBSIM 0040f4f0), slot +0x40.

entries.name: WeaponMount_GetEnergyPriority
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: the energy priority slot +0x4c: the charge target +0x7b, or 10000 while the mid-charge byte +0x43 is set. ES2's WeaponMount_GetEnergyPriority (DBSIM 0040f504), slot +0x48.

entries.name: WeaponMount_AmmoCountsInCombatRating
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: the ammunition and grenade combat-rating slot +0x58: whether the rounds +0x7b are at least the template's int16 +0x3a shifted right 3. ES2's WeaponMount_AmmoCountsInCombatRating (DBSIM 0040f520), slot +0x54.

entries.name: WeaponMount_MuzzleOffset
entries.description: (mount), callee-cleaned: adds the hardpoint record's (+0x18) int16 +0x10, +0x12 and +0x14 to the triple WeaponMountTemplate_SideMuzzleOffset (0000bbd4)(the template +0x1c, the hardpoint's signed byte +6) returns, and returns that pointer. ES2's WeaponMount_MuzzleOffset (DBSIM 0040f540).

entries.name: WeaponMount_Destroy
entries.description: (mount, throw, machine) in stack order, callee-cleaned: with the destroyed byte +0x49 clear, clears the model +0x10, sets +0x49, and transforms WeaponMount_MuzzleOffset (0000b918)(mount) by the hardpoint bone's node frame (slot +0x24 of the shape instance under the machine's +0x2e) concatenated with Context_GetTransform(machine + 6). With throw non-zero and the hardpoint's byte +6 below 4, it takes the point +0x14 of the machine's slot +0x28 answer through Context_GetTransform(machine + 6), a Math_EulerToward bearing from it to the mount point, creates 00006168(0, the mount point, WeaponModels_Mechwpn2Roots (000bc2c8)[the template's int16 +0x26]), stores the dword at 000bc2b8 in its +0x4a, calls 00006378(it, the bearing's third int16, the hardpoint record's dword +0x18), and gives it the frame's angles at +6 and 0 at +0x2c. ES2's WeaponMount_Destroy (DBSIM 0040f57c), which throws a visible gun whatever its third argument and takes that argument as the debris' lifetimes. es2_xref.py finds calls from 00013250 (throw 0) and 00013b44 (throw 1).

entries.name: WeaponMount_StaticInitNoOp
entries.description: Frameless: a bare RET, entry 000adbec of the static constructor table, the weapon mount classes' object file's last code; three zero bytes follow it before HeapPtr_DtorGunlistCopy (0000baf0). ES2's WeaponMount_StaticInitNoOp (DBSIM 0040f780).

entries.name: HeapPtr_DtorGunlistCopy
entries.description: (p, flags), callee-cleaned: byte for byte the code of HeapPtr_DtorSimObjectCopy (0000d68c), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: ConfigPart_DtorGunlistCopy
entries.description: (part, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of the vtable 00091142: byte for byte the code of ConfigPart_DtorGroupsCopy (0001c84c), relocated operands aside, storing 00091142 and 00091176 where that stores 00092142 and 00092176.

entries.name: ConfigPart_GetClassTagGunlistCopy
entries.description: Frameless: a NOP, then XOR EAX,EAX and RET 4: returns 0. Slot +4 of the vtable 00091142, and slot +4 of the vtable ElfMountVtable (00091302) (entered at 0000bb58), and slot +4 of the vtable GrenadeMountVtable (00091376) (entered at 0000bb58), and slot +4 of the vtable EnergyMountVtable (0009142e) (entered at 0000bb58), and slot +4 of the vtable WeaponMountBaseVtable (000914a2) (entered at 0000bb58), and slot +4 of the vtable AmmunitionMountVtable (00091516) (entered at 0000bb58); the code of ConfigPart_GetClassTagGroupsCopy (0001c88b).

entries.name: TSPartBase_DtorGunlistCopy
entries.description: (part, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of the vtable 00091176 (entered at its padding 0000bb5d): byte for byte the code of TSPartBase_Dtor (0005d614), relocated operands aside, storing 00091176 where that stores 000974aa. ES2's TSPartBase_Dtor (DBSIM 0049224b).

entries.name: WeaponMountTemplate_ReadRecord
entries.description: (template, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: HercPiece_ReadRecord (00009890) into +0, Collision_ReadCluster (0000938c) into +0x12, 0x30 bytes into +0x22, then 0 into +0x48. ES2's WeaponMountTemplate_ReadRecord (DBSIM 0040f8bc).

entries.name: WeaponMountTemplate_SideMuzzleOffset
entries.description: (template, mounting code) in stack order, callee-cleaned: sets the byte WeaponMountTemplate_SideMuzzleOffsetInit (000af1f4) to 1 when it is 0; copies the template's three int16 at +0x46 to the vector at WeaponMountTemplate_SideMuzzleOffsetVec (000af1f8) and zeroes its y; then, by the code through the jump table 00091240, 0 zeroes x, 1 negates z and zeroes x, 2 negates x and zeroes z, 3 zeroes z and 4 zeroes both, and a code above 4 leaves the copy; returns WeaponMountTemplate_SideMuzzleOffsetVec (000af1f8). ES2's WeaponMountTemplate_SideMuzzleOffset (DBSIM 0040f904). es2_xref finds one call, from WeaponMount_MuzzleOffset (0000b918).

entries.name: WeaponModels_LoadShapeChunks
entries.description: No arguments: opens dts\mechwpns, or dts\mwpnsb while g_LowMemory (000bda98) is set, through ResourcePath_BuildFolderName (00060698) with the folder 000980c8 names and VolRStream_CtorFromPath (000567cc); zeroes the count WeaponModels_ShapeChunkCount (000bc412) and, while ClassItem_PeekTypeTag (0005533c) finds a tag, asserts at severity 5 (gunlist.cpp line 0x7d) unless it is 0x140008, stores ClassItem_TagTotalSize (000555ec) of it in the next entry of WeaponModels_ShapeChunkSizes (000bc372) and operator_new (000015a4) of that in the next entry of WeaponModels_ShapeChunks (000bc2d2), reads that many bytes into it with VolRStream_Read (00056d70) and counts it; then VolRStream_Dtor (00056824)(stream, 2). ES2's WeaponModels_LoadShapeChunks (DBSIM 0040f998), which always opens dts\mechwpns. es2_xref finds one call, from DBSim_SpawnMissionObjects (0001e638).

entries.name: WeaponModels_FreeShapeChunks

entries.name: Ai_SelectTarget
entries.description: (this, mask) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the AI's target acquisition. Walks the object pointer array at *LiveObjectList (000bc416) (count int16 LiveObjectList_Count (000bc41c), a null entry ending it) and returns the best-scoring candidate, or 0. A candidate must pass Ai_IsTargetable (0000dce8)(this, mask, candidate). The group (+0x3f) designates it when Group_IsOrderTarget (0001ce3c)(group, candidate) holds and the group's word +4 is 1. A candidate with its byte +0x9e set is skipped unless the group designates it and the group's byte +0x14 is set. Its tier is 2 * d + 1, less 1 when any of its bytes +0x9f, +0x9e and +0x93 is set, d being 1 when the group designates it or mask bit 0 is clear; one below the tier bar (0 at the start) is skipped. Score: b = 0x1000 - (|bearing error| >> 3), the error being the heading from this +0x20 to the candidate's +0x20 (Math_HeadingToward) less this's heading +0xa, 0 with mask 0x20; Q10(100, b), raised inside a Math_DistanceBetweenPoints range of 25000 to b / max(range >> 11, 1) when that is larger; then Q10-multiplied by the weight tables 00091620 (candidate's +0x15e is this, unless mask bit 1), 00091628 (candidate's behaviour descriptor byte +9 clear), 00091630 (candidate's +0x15e is another object) and 00091638 (by the candidate's int16 +0x162), the first three indexed by this's vtable +0x50 (this, candidate); and divided by one more than the candidate's holders +0x15c, less one when this's +0x15e is the candidate, unless mask bit 2. A higher score or a higher tier replaces the best and sets the bar to its tier. ES2's Ai_SelectTarget (DBSIM 00411fa0) adds the cone limit and the range caps, scores Q10(70, b) and b / (range >> 12) inside 60000, and adds the locally-piloted test and the own-class mask bit.

Then, when d is below Detection_ContactScanRange (0001f814)(): unless each holds the other as a contact (+0xbc + the other's int16 +0x45), with h = Math_HeadingToward (00063cc8) from the machine's +0x20 to the entry's, when the machine's slot +0x48(machine, its slot +0x40 + h) and Detection_LineOfSight (0000e55c)(machine, entry) answer non-zero, the machine's slot +0x4c(machine, entry) and then Detection_ShareContact (0000e618)(machine, entry), or with the machine's +0x9d set its own contact byte set instead; and when the entry's slot +0x48(entry, its slot +0x40 + h - 0x8000) and Detection_LineOfSight (0000e55c)(machine, entry) answer non-zero, Detection_ShareContact (0000e618)(entry, machine). When each holds the other and d is below 50000: the entry's +0x98 set, Action_Activate (0001cc5c) of the machine's dword +0x16c unless it is 0 or the machine's +0x9c is set, the machine's +0x98 set, and the entry's +0x16c the same way. ES2's Detection_Sweep (DBSIM 004128f8), which paints within 200000, each object on its own terms within 140000, and looks within 80000. es2_xref finds two calls, from Sim_DetectionTick (0000e240).

entries.description: (group, verb), callee-cleaned: the group report, a line index. With tier Group_ConditionTier (0000ecc0) held to at most 3, c Group_OrderSubjectCondition (0000ee84) and a Group_OrderSubjectArrivedAndClear (0000f99c): verbs 0-6 as ES2's Group_StatusLineIndex (DBSIM 00412f90), the route cursor at the group's +6; verb 7: !a or c 4, tier+5; c 0 and tier < 2, 1; c < 2 and tier <= 2, 2; c < 3 and tier <= 2, 3; else 4. ES2's Mission_PollStatus (DBSIM 004131ac), which also evaluates every tick outside the mission box. es2_xref finds one call, from 00059700, which pushes LocalPlayerMech (000b5b86).

entries.name: Behaviour_BuildStateTable
entries.description: Static constructor (its pointer is at 000adbf4, in the XI range __cinit walks) that fills the 20 behaviour state descriptors of BehaviourStateTable (000af26c): name, dwell, the 16-bit flag mask expanded by Behaviour_ExpandFlagBits, the think, move and reassess functions and the closing dword. The states, in order: deciding, player, attacking, flanking, facing off, attacking base, attacking flyer, patrolling, travelling, bulldog travel, search destroy, sleeping, skirting, guarding, driving off en, ramming, fleeing, in limbo, dead, disabled. Dwell is 50000 for the five combat states and driving off en, 30000 for fleeing, 0 for deciding, dead and disabled, and 10 otherwise. ES2's Behaviour_BuildStateTable (DBSIM 00413ed4) builds 22.

ES2's Mech_ApplySquadCondition (DBSIM 00415068). es2_xref finds one call, from DBSim_SpawnMissionObjects (0001e638).

Entry 0 is not written. ES2's Component_FillDamageReadouts (DBSIM 004151a4). es2_xref finds one call, from Mech_ReadDamageReadouts (0001583c).

ES2's Mech_WeightedArmorRemaining (DBSIM 0041537c), the same weights. es2_xref finds one call, from Mech_SalvageValue (00014034).

entries.name: Mech_Constructor
entries.description: (mech, type) in stack order, callee-cleaned: builds a mech of the chassis type. Takes mech from the pool g_MechPool (000af68c) when null, returning 0 when that gives none; 00002ac8(mech, the type's g_MechTypeTable record + 0xc6); vtable 00091a6a at +2; ObjectList_Add (0000db10)(LiveObjectList (000bc416), mech); 00009b8c(+0x19c, 0x15, 0x1c); three 5-byte elements at +0x1ee by __vec_ctor; vtable 00091ae6, type tag 7, the record (0x1c4 bytes, by MechTypeSlot_GetIndex) at +0x188, 10000 at +0x228; Shield_Init (0000fabc)(+0x1b8, record +0xc0); 00001f48(mech, record +0x12) into +0x1c0, and for record +0x1c and +0x24 into +0x1c4 and +0x1c8 unless negative; a TSObj per byte of the record's +0x72 list below 0x80, from pool 000af044 on shape 000bc1d8[byte], at +0x1cc with the count at +0x1d0; Behaviour_SetState(+0x47) by the byte +0x9d; then Damage_LoadMechDmgFile (00009a2c)(dmg\<g_MechTypeNames[record +0x6c]>) into +0x190, 00009580(col\<same name>) into +0x18c and 00009c28(+0x19c, that, +0x190, mech). One call found by es2_xref, from DBSim_SpawnMissionObjects (0001e638). ES2's Mech_Constructor (DBSIM 00415bb0), whose record is 0x21e bytes and whose damage arrays are 0x1d by 0x16.

entries.name: Mech_LocomotionTick
entries.description: (mech, avoidance arg, desired speed, steer) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the HERC control law and gait machine, with the type record at +0x188. An immobilised machine (+0x9e) has desired speed and steer zeroed. Otherwise, while 00064178(mech + 0x203) reports the timer running, the desired speed becomes the type's +4 when +0xa8 is set and +6 when not; once it reports 0 the desired speed is clamped to [+4, +6]. A machine other than the player (PlayerMech (000bc42a)) that is not immobilised runs 00011c80. Damage scales the desired speed by Q10 400 (+0xa3) or 750 (+0xa2), steer is clamped to +/-0x100, and the speed +0x224 moves toward the desired speed by typeRec +8 (Math_RateLimitedMoveToward). The gait machine then compares |speed| with last tick's on the locomotion thread +0x1c0, cutting to or requesting the type's sequences +0xe, +0x10, +0x12, +0x14, +0x46 and +0x7c with AnimThread_SetSequence (0006200c) and AnimThread_SetTarget (0006265c) and setting the playback rate +0x236: an immobilised machine off +0x7c falls to +0x46, requesting it at rate 100 with Sound_PlayAt 0x1e at +0x20 unless +0xae is latched, then running at rate 0x78 and, once the sequence has played, latching +0xae, calling 00013078(mech, 0x78, 0x96) and playing 0x29. The turn rate +0x222 then moves by typeRec +0xa toward Q8(steer, tent): the tent is 0 when a gait branch set its step flag this tick or |speed| is below 45; otherwise it rises from 0 at 45 to typeRec +2 midway between 45 and the top speed +6, and falls to half that at the top speed. The heading +0xa takes the turn rate and +0x2c, the orientation block's cached-rotation word, is cleared. ES2's Mech_LocomotionTick (DBSIM 00416a04) adds the terrain slope, the Turbo Pod and the minimum playback rate, and peaks its tent at Q10(1600).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00012038, against ES2's Mech_LocomotionTick

entries.name: Mech_ApplyFormationOffset

entries.name: Mech_SalvageValue
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: 0 when the byte +0xad is set. Otherwise, for each hardpoint of the list at +0x198 (pointer array at +0, int16 count at +4) whose reading FUN_0000a16c(+0x19c, 0x13 + the byte +0x17 of the hardpoint's +0x18) is below 0x80, passes the pair {the int16 +0x56 of the hardpoint's +0x1c, ((0x100 - reading) * 100) >> 8} to Salvage_QueueWeapon; then returns Math_Q10Multiply(Mech_WeightedArmorRemaining(+0x19c), the type record's (+0x188) int16 +0x54), that second value halved when component 0 reads 0x100. ES2's Mech_SalvageValue (DBSIM 00418e60) with the machine's fields 0x6a lower from the type record on.

entries.name: Mech_IsEcmSwitchedOn

ES2's Mech_IsEcmSwitchedOn (DBSIM 0041aa10), which reads its ECM pod's +0x7d, the piloted byte +0xa3 and the radar mode +0x96. es2_xref.py finds one call, from 00014ee0.

entries.name: Mech_ReadDamageReadouts

ES2's Mech_ReadDamageReadouts (DBSIM 0041b4ec), whose type record and component damage are at +0x1f2 and +0x206.

entries.name: Mech_ReadEntryDamage

Player_DependentCondition (0002e334) passes (machine, n, 0), where ES2's passes kind 0 and index n. ES2's Mech_ReadEntryDamage (DBSIM 0041b514), on the machine's +0x206.

entries.name: Mech_LoadResources
entries.description: No arguments: sets the 16-byte slot map g_MechTypeSlotIndex (000bc430) to 0xff and the slot count g_MechTypeCount (000bc42e) to 0; reads dat\mforms (asserting at severity 5, mechsys.cpp line 0x30, when the stream status is set): an int16 count to 000bc448 and that many 0x1c-byte records, constructed by MechFormation_ElementCtor (000199e4), to the pointer at 000bc44a; then, when g_LowMemory (000bda98) is 0, loads dba\light, medium, heavy and enemy (the name table 00091de4) with ClassItem_LoadFromFile into the four dwords at g_MechTextureGroupSlots (000bc450). ES2's Mech_LoadResources (DBSIM 0041fdb0), whose slot map is 0x55 bytes and which packs seven banks into atlases.

entries.name: MechFormation_ElementCtor
entries.description: (formation), callee-cleaned: allocates 0x1c bytes when formation is null, then __vec_ctor over its seven 4-byte slots with MechFormation_SlotCtor (00019a14) (passed as the padding entry 00019a12); returns formation. Mech_LoadResources passes it as 000199e3. ES2's MechFormation_ElementCtor (DBSIM 004207bb).

entries.name: MechFormation_SlotCtor
entries.description: (slot), callee-cleaned: allocates 4 bytes when slot is null and returns it, storing nothing; the element constructor MechFormation_ElementCtor runs over a formation's seven slots, where ES2's passes Rtl_ReturnArgCopy.

entries.name: MechTypeSlot_GetIndex
entries.description: (type), callee-cleaned: returns the byte for type in the slot map g_MechTypeSlotIndex (000bc430), 0xff when the type has no slot. ES2's maybe_MechTypeSlot_GetIndex (DBSIM 0041ff00).

entries.name: MechTypeSlot_Allocate
entries.description: (type), callee-cleaned: when MechTypeSlot_GetIndex(type) is 0xff, stores the slot count g_MechTypeCount (000bc42e) in the type's map byte, increments the count and takes GunLayout_Reserve(1), keeping its result in 000bc44e when the count has become 1; then, every call, CollisionTable_Reserve(1) and DmgTable_Reserve(1). One caller found by es2_xref, in DBSim_LoadScriptDat (0001d850). ES2's maybe_MechTypeSlot_Allocate (DBSIM 0041ff10).

entries.name: Shape_RemapTransformIds
entries.description: (nodeCount, map, part) in stack order, callee-cleaned: takes the part's class tag from its vtable +4, finds it among the ten tags at 00091e14 (0x140005, 0x1e0005, 0x140006 return; 0x140014, 0x140015 and 0x14000b each have a handler; 0x1e0003, 0x140008, 0x140007 and 0x14000c share one) and jumps through the handler table after them; returns for any other tag. The handlers (00019aef to 00019b93) are undefined bytes in Ghidra and were not read. ES2's Shape_RemapTransformIds (DBSIM 0041ff88), whose tag comes from vtable +0 and whose arguments are (part, map, nodeCount).

entries.name: MechType_RemapDetailRootTransforms
entries.description: (partIds, detailSet) in stack order, callee-cleaned: with more than one root (int16 detailSet+0xc), fills a 400-byte stack table with 0xff; for each part id up to 50 or the first negative, finds the part in root 0 through the root's vtable +0x24 and, for each later root that has it, stores root 0's transform id (part+4) at that root's row [its own transform id]; then Shape_RemapTransformIds for each root after the first with its row and int16 +0x10 of root 0's +0x2a record. ES2's MechType_RemapDetailRootTransforms (DBSIM 00420090), whose find goes through vtable +0x20 and whose arguments are (detailSet, partIds).

entries.name: MechType_InitOne
entries.description: (type), callee-cleaned: loads one chassis into its slot's 0x1c4-byte record in g_MechTypeTable (000bc444). Reads 0xc0 bytes of dat\<name> (name from g_MechTypeNames (000bc440)) into +2 with Ovl_ReadFile, stores the slot at +0 and the type at +0x6c; Shape_LoadAllRoots(skip, 0x1e0003, dts\<name>, +0xc6), skip being int16 +0x48 when g_LowMemory (000bda98) is set and 0 otherwise; the count to +0xd2, g_ShapeDetailThresholds (00091dac) to +0xca and a __vec_new of count CONNECT_INFO_Ctor pairs to +0xce; MechType_RemapDetailRootTransforms(+0x30, +0xc6); GunLayout_LoadForMechType(slot + 000bc44e, gl\<name>) and GunLayout_CollectHardpointBones; per root MechType_BindHardpointSlots and root+0x26 = the dword at g_MechTextureGroupSlots (000bc450) + int16 +0x96 * 4; PaperDoll_Load(slot, name) to +0xc2. ES2's MechType_InitOne (DBSIM 004201a8), which reads 0xd8 bytes, skips no roots, stores a slot address at +0x26, rescales the speeds and has flyer and debris steps.

entries.name: CONNECT_INFO_Ctor
entries.description: (info), callee-cleaned: allocates 6 bytes when info is null, zeroes the dword at +0 and returns info. ES2's CONNECT_INFO_Ctor (DBSIM 004207db).

entries.name: Mechs_InitAllTypes
entries.description: No arguments: LoadNameList(10, 0x60, 0, 'mechs') in stack order into g_MechTypeNames (000bc440); __vec_new of the int16 mech type count g_MechTypeCount (000bc42e) records of 0x1c4 bytes, element constructor MECH_TYPE_DATA_Ctor (00019f40) passed as its padding entry 00019f3e, into g_MechTypeTable (000bc444); PaperDoll_InitTables (00030288)(count); then for each type number from 0 to 15 whose MechTypeSlot_GetIndex (00019a30)(type) is not 0xff, MechType_InitOne (00019cf0)(type). ES2's Mechs_InitAllTypes (DBSIM 0042049c), whose table has 0x55 entries, whose records are 0x21e bytes and which walks all 0x55 type numbers.

entries.name: MECH_TYPE_DATA_Ctor
entries.description: (data), callee-cleaned: allocates 0x1c4 bytes when data is null, __vec_ctor's ten 0x18-byte ConfigPart_Ctor parts at +0xd4 and returns data; Mechs_InitAllTypes passes it as the padding entry 00019f3e. ES2's MECH_TYPE_DATA_Ctor (DBSIM 00420817), whose parts are at +0xec.

entries.name: ConfigPart_Ctor
entries.description: (part), callee-cleaned: allocates 0x18 bytes when part is null, stores the vptrs 00091e6e, 00091e92 and 00091d7a at +0 in turn, runs ShapeInstance_CtorCellFrames(part+0x10, 0) and stores the vptr 00091d46; returns part. ES2's ConfigPart_Ctor (DBSIM 0042067c).

entries.name: Formation_GetSlotOffset
entries.description: (slot, formation) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies the int16 (x, y) at 000bc44a + formation * 0x1c + slot * 4 - 4 (MFORMS.DAT's 28-byte formations) to the static point 000af720 and returns it, its z 000af724 set to 0 on the first call (flag 000af71d). Neither number is checked. ES2's Formation_GetSlotOffset (DBSIM 004205cc).

entries.name: Mech_GetGunLayout
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: GunLayout_GetBySlot (0000c18c)(the int16 at +0 of the machine's type record +0x188, plus the int16 at 000bc44e) and returns its result, the machine's hardpoint list: an int16 count at +0 and 0x1a-byte records from the pointer at +2. ES2's Mech_GetGunLayout (DBSIM 00420634), which reads +0x1f2. es2_xref finds two calls, from 00012c0f and PaperDoll_BuildWeaponIcons (0003058c).

entries.name: Computer_PostMessage
entries.description: (id), callee-cleaned: posts a message to the cockpit computer's port at CockpitViewInstance (00092d1c) + 0x207 with MessagePort_Post (0002ed94)(port, record), the record's first int16 the id and its second 0. ES2's Computer_PostMessage (DBSIM 00420a68) posts through the port's vtable slot 0 at +0x20b.

entries.name: Ai_PostSquadMessage

ES2's Ai_PostSquadMessage (DBSIM 00420a98), which tests +0x99 and posts through the port's vtable slot 0.

entries.name: Flyer_ApplyFormationOffset
entries.description: (object, position) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Mech_ApplyFormationOffset (00012ed0) with FlyerFormation_GetSlotOffset (0001c7f0) for the slot's three int16. ES2's Flyer_ApplyFormationOffset (DBSIM 00421e98). Callers found by es2_xref: 0001b574, 0001ba88.

entries.name: Flyer_LoadResources
entries.description: No arguments, flyersys.cpp, the phase-2 subsystem loader Flyer_RegisterSubsystem (0001c814) registers: sets the 2-byte flyer type-slot table 000bc466 to 0xff and the count 000bc464 to 0; opens dat\fforms (severity-5 assert, line 0x26, when the stream status is set), reads the int16 count to 000bc470 and count * 0x12 bytes into an array of FlyerFormation_ElementCtor (0001c618) elements __vec_new builds at 000bc472. ES2's Flyer_LoadResources (DBSIM 00422d90), whose slot table is 0x22 bytes.

entries.name: FlyerFormation_ElementCtor
entries.description: (this) callee-cleaned: the __vec_new element constructor Flyer_LoadResources (0001c558) passes for the 18-byte FFORMS.DAT records. Allocates 0x12 bytes when this is null and returns null when that fails; otherwise __vec_ctor(0001c646, 3, 6, this) over the three 6-byte slots. Returns this. ES2's FlyerFormation_ElementCtor (DBSIM 00423078).

entries.name: FlyerType_RecordIndex
entries.description: (type), callee-cleaned: returns the byte at 000bc466 + type, the type's record index, 0xff when it has none. ES2's FlyerType_RecordIndex (DBSIM 00422e80).
