entries.name: MonoScreen_Ctor
entries.description: (screen), callee-cleaned: allocates 2 bytes when screen is null; sets +1 to 1 and +0 to 1 when Crtc_DetectDualDisplay (0007634a) finds both adapters, else 0. Returns screen. Mono_StaticInit (0006102c) builds Mono_Screen (000b5e70) with it.

entries.name: Mono_Clear
entries.description: Frameless: fills the 2000 cells of the monochrome text screen (linear 0xb0000, addressed as 0009003c + 0xb0000) with 0x0720, a space in attribute 7, while the bytes Mono_Screen (000b5e70) and 000b5e71 share a set bit.

entries.name: Mono_WriteChar
entries.description: (ch, row, column) in stack order, callee-cleaned: writes ch with the attribute byte 00097fa0 to the monochrome screen cell (row * 80 + column) while the bytes Mono_Screen (000b5e70) and 000b5e71 share a set bit and row is 0-24. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Mono_WriteText
entries.description: (text, row, column) in stack order, callee-cleaned: writes a NUL-terminated string with the attribute byte 00097fa0 to the monochrome screen from the cell (row * 80 + column), under Mono_WriteChar's gate. ES2's MonoDevice_WriteText goes through a device object.

entries.name: Mono_Printf
entries.description: (column, row, format, ...), C convention: vsprintf into a 256-byte buffer and Mono_WriteText(buffer, row, column), under Mono_WriteChar's gate. The memory, driver and slot listings at 0004e858 and the grenade distance at GrenadeMount_PushGaugeState (0000b714) print with it. ES2's Mono_Printf (DBSIM 00495508).

entries.name: Mono_PrintScreen
entries.description: (printer), callee-cleaned: under Mono_WriteChar's gate, opens LPT<printer digit> and writes the monochrome screen's 2000 cells to it: before each character the PCL escape ESC(s0B for attribute 7 or ESC(s7B (bold) otherwise, a NUL printed as a space, CR LF after every 80; each cell shows 0x0fdb while it is written and is put back with a NUL turned into a space. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Mono_ShowCursor
entries.description: (show), callee-cleaned: while Mono_Screen's two bytes share a set bit, maybe_MonoCrtc_ShowCursor (0007633b) when show is non-zero, else maybe_MonoCrtc_HideCursor (0007632c). No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Mono_StaticInit
entries.description: No arguments: MonoScreen_Ctor(Mono_Screen, Mono_Screen (000b5e70)). Its address is the static-constructor table's entry at 000adc78, which __cinit runs at startup.

entries.name: __vec_new
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__vec_new`, from `vecnew.cpp`: (ctor, count, size, p) in stack order, callee-cleaned; 6.1's library declares it (p, size, count, ctor). When p is null it allocates count * size + 4 bytes with operator_new and returns null when that fails. Stores count in the first dword, calls ctor (when non-null) on each element from the next dword at size intervals, and returns the address after the count.

entries.name: __vec_delete
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__vec_delete`, from `vecnew.cpp`: (dtor, size, flags, p) in stack order, callee-cleaned; 6.1's library declares it (p, free, size, dtor). When p is non-null: when dtor is non-null, calls dtor(element, 2) on each element, last first, their count read from the dword before p; then calls operator_delete(p - 4) when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: __vec_ctor
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__vec_ctor`, from `vecnew.cpp`: (ctor, count, size, p) in stack order, callee-cleaned; 6.1's library declares it (p, size, count, ctor). When p and ctor are both non-null it calls ctor on each of the count elements at size intervals from p; it returns p.

entries.name: __vec_dtor
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__vec_dtor`, from `vecnew.cpp`: (dtor, count, size, p) in stack order, callee-cleaned; 6.1's library declares it (p, size, count, dtor). When p and dtor are both non-null it calls dtor(element, 2) on each of the count elements at size intervals from p, the last first; 2 is DTORmostderived.

entries.name: ANSequence_NextFrame
entries.description: (sequence, frame), callee-cleaned: frame + 1 while it is below the frame count (+0xa) less 1, else frame. ANSequence's vtable 000ad96a slot +0x24. ES2's ANSequence_NextFrame (DBSIM 00478654).

entries.name: ANSequence_PrevFrame
entries.description: (sequence, frame), frameless, callee-cleaned: frame - 1, or 0 for frame 0. ANSequence's vtable 000ad96a slot +0x28. ES2's ANSequence_PrevFrame (DBSIM 00478670).

entries.name: ANSequence_FrameShortOfTarget
entries.description: (sequence, offset, target, frame) in stack order, frameless, callee-cleaned: 1 in AX when frame < target, or frame == target and offset is 0; otherwise 0. ANSequence's vtable 000ad96a slot +0x2c. ES2's ANSequence_FrameShortOfTarget (DBSIM 00478680), arguments reversed.

entries.name: ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetBackward

entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `stricmp`, from `strings.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 82 bytes from here.

entries.name: Region_CopyRectBetweenPages
entries.description: (region, offset), C convention: the same statements as ES1GO's Region_CopyRectBetweenPages (000519bc). ES2's Region_CopyRectBetweenPages (DBSIM 00487ad0).

entries.name: Region_CopySpansBetweenPages
entries.description: (region, offset), C convention: the same statements as ES1GO's Region_CopySpansBetweenPages (00051aed). ES2's Region_CopySpansBetweenPages (DBSIM 00487c01).

entries.name: Region_CopyBetweenPages
entries.description: (region, offset), C convention: copies what a region covers from the raster source page to the draw page: Region_CopyRectBetweenPages (00066690) for type 0, Region_CopySpansBetweenPages (000667c1) for type 2, nothing for another type. ES1GO's Region_CopyBetweenPages; ES2's (DBSIM 00487d54).

entries.name: Cursor_SetImage
entries.description: (bitmap, hotspot), C convention: hides the cursor (g_RasterRoutines slot 31, 0009df50) while it is shown (00098d6c), stores bitmap at 00098d68 and the hotspot's two dwords at 00098d78, frees the save-under buffer 00098d8a, and for a non-null bitmap stores its int16s +0 and +2 at 00098d80 and 00098d82 and their product at 00098d86, allocates that many bytes as the new save-under, and shows the cursor again (slot 30) when it was shown and the allocation succeeded.

entries.name: Cursor_SyncPosition
entries.description: (point), C convention: when the dword 00098d96 is set, copies the point to 00098d70/00098d74, between calls through 0009df50 and 0009df4c when the dword 00098d6c is set; otherwise copies it to 00098d9a/00098d9e. ES2's Cursor_SyncPosition (DBSIM 00486d70), statement for statement.

entries.name: Cursor_GetPosition
entries.description: (out), C convention: copies the point at 00098d70/00098d74, which Cursor_SyncPosition (000669dc) writes, to out. ES2's Cursor_GetPosition (DBSIM 00486dc2).

entries.name: Bitmap_Blit
entries.description: (bitmap, flags, point) in stack order, callee-cleaned: draws a bitmap object's data (+4) at point with Raster_BlitDispatch (0006a8e0)(data, point, flags). A packed bitmap (+0x12 non-zero) is first unpacked by 000672cc into Bitmap_UnpackScratch (000bdbe2), which stands in for the data pointer +0xe, with the unpacked size in +0xa, during the draw; afterwards both fields are put back and the scratch buffer is deleted unless Bitmap_UseCallerScratch (000bdbde) is set. ES2's Bitmap_Blit (DBSIM 0048159c), which reaches the clip dispatcher through GL_Blit.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00067048, against ES2's Bitmap_Blit

entries.name: Bitmap_BlitScaled
entries.description: (bitmap, size, flags, point) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the same statements as ES1GO's Bitmap_BlitScaled (000503f0): Bitmap_BlitScaledClipDispatch (00076884)(header +4, point, flags, size), a packed bitmap (+0x12 non-zero) first unpacked by 000672cc into Bitmap_UnpackScratch for the call. ES2's Bitmap_BlitScaled (DBSIM 004816bc) reaches the same dispatch through GL_BlitScaled.

entries.name: Bitmap_BlitRotatedUnpacked
entries.description: (bitmap, angle, size, flip, position) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's Bitmap_BlitRotatedUnpacked (DBSIM 00481750): a packed bitmap (+0x12) is unpacked by 000672cc into Bitmap_UnpackScratch, standing in for +0xe and +0xa for the call and freed after unless Bitmap_UseCallerScratch; then Bitmap_BlitRotatedScaled (00076630)(bitmap + 4, position, flip, size, angle) directly where ES2 goes through a thunk.

entries.name: GLBitmapArray_Dtor
entries.description: (array, flags), callee-cleaned: returns for none; otherwise stores the vtable 0009b066, destroys each of the count +4 bitmaps of the table +8 that is not 0 through its +0x1c slot with 3, frees the table, and deletes the array when bit 0 of flags is set. The same statements as ES1GO's GLBitmapArray_Dtor (0005343c).

entries.name: strncpy
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `strncpy`, from `strings.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 84 bytes from here.

entries.name: Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch
entries.description: (count, points), C convention: draws a polygon with the brush {mode, colour} at the installed clip block's (00098d64) +0x228, translating the points by (+0x20c - +0x21c, +0x210 - +0x220) first when +0x208 is set. Fewer than three points, or brush mode 4, draw in the brush colour through a temporary brush at +0x224: one point through Gfx_PlotPixel (00069058), two through Raster_DrawLine, more as a line loop. For three or more: mode 0 fills through g_RasterRoutines slot 0 with the colour (a palette index for top byte 0, the ramp entry from 0009a6f5 for top byte 4, nothing otherwise), mode 1 goes to 0007965c, modes 5 and 7 to the routine at 0009df58, mode 6 fills through slot 1 (0009ded8) with the brush's second field. The fills scan-convert with 00076f54 and clip per the clip mode +0x204: 0 none, 1 through 000788e4 against the rect at +0x20c, otherwise against each region of the block's list (rects through 000788e4, span regions through 00073b7c). es2_naming.py diff finds it identical to ES2's Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch (DBSIM 00483dac) but for labels.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00068be0, against ES2's Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch

entries.name: Raster_DrawPolygonReversed
entries.description: (count, points), C convention: ES2's Raster_DrawPolygonReversed (DBSIM 00484116): for three or more points copies them last to first into a local ring and, when the brush at the clip block's (00098d64) +0x228 is mode 5, points its +8 list at a reversed local copy for the call; then Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch.

entries.name: Raster_DrawPolygonEitherWinding
entries.description: (count, points), C convention: ES2's Raster_DrawPolygonEitherWinding (DBSIM 004841af): for three or more points sums the signed area in 64 bits and hands a sum of zero or less to Raster_DrawPolygonReversed; anything else, and rings of one or two points, to Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch. Nothing for a count of 0.

entries.name: Gfx_PlotPixel
entries.description: (point), C convention: ES2's Gfx_PlotPixel (DBSIM 004894e0), the same statements after normalisation. Reads the brush through the canvas 00098d64's +0x224: mode 0 resolves the colour by its top byte (0 the value, 4 ramp entry (bits 16-23 * length) >> 8 of g_RasterColourRamps, else nothing) and plots through 0009dee8; mode 2 hands brush + 4 to 0009deec; other modes plot nothing. Adds the canvas origin when +0x208 is set and clips by +0x204: 0 none, 1 the rect +0x20c-+0x218, otherwise the canvas's list of rects and span lists.

entries.name: Raster_SetColourRamps
entries.description: (first, count, records, extra), C convention: copies count 8-byte records {int16 *entries, int16 length} into g_RasterColourRamps (0009a6f5) from index first, two LODSD/STOSD a record; extra goes to EBX unread. ES2's Raster_SetColourRamps (DBSIM 00486d04).

entries.name: Raster_GetColourRamps
entries.description: (first, count, out, extra), C convention: Raster_SetColourRamps (000691f8) the other way, copying count records of g_RasterColourRamps (0009a6f5) from index first to out. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: GLPalette_Dtor
entries.description: (palette, flags), callee-cleaned: returns for none; otherwise stores the vtable 0009b3b6, frees the colours +8 when the word +4 is non-zero, frees each of the word +0xc's eight-byte records' first dword in the table +0x10 and then the table when +0xc is non-zero, stores the vtable 0009b3de and deletes the palette when bit 0 of flags is set. The same statements as ES1GO's GLPalette_Dtor (0005a824).

entries.name: Palette_UploadWhole
entries.description: (palette), callee-cleaned: the routine at 0009df08 with the palette's first entry +6, count +4 and colours +8, then Raster_SetColourRamps (000691f8) with its first ramp +0xe, ramp count +0xc, records +0x10 and +6. The counterpart of ES2's Palette_UploadWhole (DBSIM 00481ed4); callers found by es2_xref: TtmScript_RunPage (0007aa58), nine calls.

entries.name: Transform2D_ApplyToPoint
entries.description: (point, xform, out), C convention: out = the {int x, int y} point through the 2x2 int16 matrix (x * m0 + y * m2, x * m1 + y * m3, each + 0x2000 >> 14 in 64 bits) plus the int32 translation at +8/+0xc. ES2's Transform2D_ApplyToPoint (DBSIM 0047ff44).

entries.name: Math_BuildRotation2D
entries.description: (angle, out), C convention: out = {cos a, sin a, -sin a, cos a} in Q14 from the cosine table 000981cc, the angle rounded to 1/4096 turn, sin a = cos(a - 0x4000). ES2's Math_BuildRotation2D (DBSIM 0047ea24).

entries.name: Ttm_ManagerCtor
entries.description: (manager, a, b, count) in stack order: allocates the 0xb-byte .TTM handle manager when given none (returning 0 when that fails); stores count at its byte +4, b at 0009f248, 000bdd28 at 0009f24c and a at 0009f250; clears the path prefix with Ttm_SetPathPrefix (00069940)(manager, 0) through its padding entry; passes clock() to srand (0007cd4a). es2_xref finds one call, from Cockpit_LoadPanel (0002c9d8), with a count of 10.

entries.name: Ttm_ManagerDtor
entries.description: (manager, flags): returns for none; otherwise passes the timer slot word +9 to 0006d337, destroys every handle's script with Ttm_CloseAll (00069a04) through its padding entry, deletes the handle table +5, and deletes the manager when bit 0 of flags is set. ES1GO's Ttm_Shutdown keeps the table in globals. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_RunAll
entries.description: (manager): returns 0 while the byte 0009b404 is 0. Otherwise notes the word 0009b406 and the installed render context 000bdbda; stores the default context 0009f248's +4 (0 with none) at +0x44 of the display object 0009f24c, through Raster_SetClipBlock when the display is 000bdd28, and installs the default context with Raster_InstallRenderContext; clears 0009b404; calls TtmScript_Run (00079a14)(script, the noted count) for each handle of the table +5 below the count byte +4 that holds a script; does the same for the noted context, subtracts the noted count from 0009b406 and returns 1. ES1GO's Ttm_RunAll (0004652e) waits for its tick instead of returning. es2_xref finds calls from Cockpit_LoadPanel (0002c9d8) and Cockpit_RunTtmScripts (0002e0ec).

entries.name: Ttm_TimerTick
entries.description: (): the timer callback of the simulator's scripts, a frameless stub: sets the byte 0009b404 to 1 and adds 1 to the word 0009b406. ES1GO's Ttm_TimerTick (00046681) first tests a byte the fades set. es2_xref finds its address stored at 0006980b, in Ttm_AllocHandles (00069780).

entries.name: Ttm_GetPage
entries.description: (manager, handle): the page byte +1 of the handle's script, or 0xffff for an empty handle. ES1GO's Ttm_GetPage (0004669f) with the manager's table. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_GetMode
entries.description: (manager, handle): the mode dword +0xe of the handle's script, without testing the handle for one. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_GetLoop
entries.description: (manager, handle): the loop flag dword +0x13 of the handle's script, without testing the handle for one. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_AllocHandles
entries.description: (manager, timer count): allocates the handle table +5, a dword per handle of the count byte +4, returning 0 when that fails, and zeroes it; takes 000bdd0c into +0, or 0006c6f8(0, 0x4da6) when that is 0, deleting the table and returning 0 when +0 is still 0; registers Ttm_TimerTick (000696f4) with Timer_AddCallback(count, it), stores the slot at the word +9 and returns 1. es2_xref finds one call, from Cockpit_LoadPanel (0002c9d8), with a count of 2.

entries.name: Ttm_SetDefaultContext
entries.description: (manager, context): stores context at 0009f248, the default render context Ttm_ManagerCtor (00069540) sets from its b and Ttm_RunAll (000695e0) installs, and returns the one before. es2_xref finds one call, from Cockpit_RunTtmScripts (0002e0ec), which passes the installed render context 000bdbda.

entries.name: Ttm_Open
entries.description: (manager, a, b, name) in stack order: returns 0xff when the count byte +4 is 0 or every handle of the table +5 holds a script; otherwise makes a script with TtmScript_Ctor (000797ac)(0) in the first empty handle and loads it with TtmScript_Load (0007a54c)(script, a, b, name), destroying it with TtmScript_Dtor (000799cc)(script, 3), emptying the handle and returning 0xff on a nonzero result; returns the handle's index. ES1GO's Ttm_Open keeps its table in globals and passes a third argument. es2_xref finds one call, from CockpitClock_Ctor (000433cc).

entries.name: Ttm_SetPage
entries.description: (manager, page, handle): when the handle holds a script and page is below its page count byte +0, stores page at +1 and returns 1; otherwise returns 0. Leaves the wait, mode and flags, which ES1GO's TtmScript_SetPage (000470e7) resets. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_SetPathPrefix
entries.description: (manager, prefix): stores the string pointer at 0009f254, the folder TtmScript_BuildPath puts before a .TTM name, and returns the one before. es2_xref finds Cockpit_LoadPanel (0002c9d8) passing ttm\ (00092f2e).

entries.name: Ttm_SetMode
entries.description: (manager, mode, handle): stores mode at the dword +0xe of the handle's script and returns 1, or returns 0 for an empty handle. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_SetLoop
entries.description: (manager, loop, handle): stores loop at the dword +0x13 of the handle's script and returns 1, or returns 0 for an empty handle. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_Close
entries.description: (manager, handle): when the handle holds a script destroys it with TtmScript_Dtor(script, 3), empties the handle and returns 1; otherwise returns 0. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_CloseAll
entries.description: (manager): destroys the script of every handle of the table +5 below the count byte +4 with TtmScript_Dtor(script, 3) and empties the handle. es2_xref finds one call, from Ttm_ManagerDtor (00069598), through the padding entry 00069a02.

entries.name: GLViewport_Ctor
entries.description: (viewport) in stack order, callee-cleaned: allocates 0x239 bytes with operator_new when viewport is null; stores 0009b40a, 0009b42e and 0009b456 in turn at +0, runs the inlined constructor of the rect at +0x210, copies 0x8b dwords from the viewport the GL display's (000bdd28) +0x40 points at to +4, and clears the byte +0x230 and the dwords +0x231 and +0x235. ES2's GLViewport_Ctor (DBSIM 00480b28): the same 0x239-byte layout, its copy made as 0x81 dwords and then +0x208-+0x22c.
entries.source: Herculan/docs/es1/simulation/mfd-missile-camera.md#the-viewport-and-the-camera; ES1DBSIM decompile at 00069a84; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 00480b28

entries.name: Raster_InstallRenderContext
entries.description: (ctx), callee-cleaned: stores ctx at 000bdbda, the installed render context, and its clip block ctx + 4 (0 for a null ctx) at the GL display's (000bdd28) +0x44; passes the block to Raster_SetClipBlock (0007599c) when 000bdd28, read again, still holds that display, and passes it to Raster_SetClipBlock (0007599c) again. ES2's Raster_InstallRenderContext (DBSIM 00480c38) does the same through GLDisplay_SetClipBlock and Raster_SetClipBlock.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM disassembly at 00069be0, against ES2's Raster_InstallRenderContext

entries.name: HudFont_GlyphWidth
entries.description: (font, c) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the int16 at font+0xc when it is not -1, otherwise the width byte at (the pointer at font+0x2a)[c - the int16 at font+8]. ES2's HudFont_GlyphWidth (DBSIM 0048238c).

entries.name: HudFont_MeasureString
entries.description: (font, text), callee-cleaned: the sum of HudFont_GlyphWidth (00069ce0)(font, c) over the characters of the NUL-terminated text. ES2's HudFont_MeasureString (DBSIM 004823e0).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00069d0c, against ES2's HudFont_MeasureString

entries.name: HudFont_CellHeight
entries.description: (font, c), callee-cleaned: returns the int16 at font + 0xa, the glyph cell height, sign-extended; c is not read. Label_SetRect passes '0'. ES2's HudFont_CellHeight (DBSIM 00482410) takes the font alone.

entries.name: HudFont_CellHeight2
entries.description: (font, text) in stack order, callee-cleaned (RET 8): returns the int16 at font+0xa sign-extended, the glyph cell height; the text argument is ignored. ES2's HudFont_CellHeight2 (DBSIM 0048241c) takes the font alone.

entries.name: HudFont_DrawGlyph
entries.description: (font, c, pen) in stack order, callee-cleaned: blits glyph c as a block HudFont_CellHeight(font, c) rows high and HudFont_GlyphWidth(font, c) wide, of the depth byte at font+0x12, its pixels at the pointer at font+0x22 plus (the offset array at font+0x26)[c - the int16 at font+8], through Raster_BlitDispatch to (pen x, pen y - the int16 at font+0x16). When the render context 000bdbda is set and its byte +0x230 is non-zero, then draws a line with Raster_DrawLine from (pen x, pen y) to (pen x + the glyph's width, pen y). ES2's HudFont_DrawGlyph (DBSIM 00482428), less the message it formats first.

entries.name: HudFont_DrawString
entries.description: (font, text, pen) in stack order, callee-cleaned: draws a NUL-terminated run from the {x, y} pen. With the installed render context's (000bdbda) +0x231 at 1 it first moves x right by the field width +0x235 less HudFont_MeasureString, at 2 by half of that. Each character goes to HudFont_DrawGlyph (00069d64)(font, c, position) and x advances by HudFont_GlyphWidth (00069ce0)(font, c). ES2's HudFont_DrawString (DBSIM 00482528).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00069e38, against ES2's HudFont_DrawString

entries.name: strncat
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `strncat`, from `strings.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 70 bytes from here.

entries.name: Raster_DrawLine
entries.description: (from, to), C convention: draws a line between two {x, y} points with the pen at the installed clip block's +0x224 (the block 00098d64 points at): mode 0 a flat colour, mode 2 a span remap through g_RasterRoutines slot 1 (0009ded8), a colour whose top byte is 4 read from the colour ramps at 0009a6f5. The points move by the block's translation when +0x208 is set. Clip mode 0 draws the whole line and mode 1 the line clipped to the rect at +0x20c (0007d4a4): a flat colour through slot 34 (0009df5c), a remap as the spans 0007d358 scan-converts it to. Other modes take each region of the list at +0: a rect region clips the line with 0007d4a4, a span region intersects the line's spans with it through 00073b7c, and each piece goes to the pen's span routine. ES2's Raster_DrawLine (DBSIM 004838f8), statement for statement.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0006a064, against ES2's Raster_DrawLine

entries.name: Str_CompareNoCaseN
entries.description: (a, b, n), C convention: compares up to n characters with toupper applied to each, stopping at a NUL in a or at the first difference, and returns the difference of the last uppercased pair as bytes; 0 for n of 0.

entries.name: GLDisplay_Ctor
entries.description: (display, kindName), callee-cleaned: allocates 0x48 bytes for a null display, GL_ClaimGlobal(display, display, 7), registers 0006a34c with 0005730c and 0006a384 with 0007d628, clears +0, and stores Raster_DriverByName(display, kindName) at +0x30. ES2's GLDisplay_Ctor (DBSIM 00480e4c). es2_xref finds no reference to it.

entries.name: GLDisplay_CtorAndOpen
entries.description: (display, bitmap, kindName), callee-cleaned: GLDisplay_Ctor's body, then GLDisplay_Open(display, bitmap). ES2's GLDisplay_CtorAndOpen (DBSIM 00480e98). Its callers found by es2_xref are Sim_CreateDisplay and 00069a68.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0006a3fc; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 00480e98

entries.name: GLDisplay_Open
entries.description: (display, bitmap), callee-cleaned: when +0 is 0: increments 0009b4cc, calling 000732ac the first time; RasterDriver_OpenDisplay(+0x30, bitmap, display + 4); on success allocates two 0x22c-byte clip blocks, sets up the first with ClipBlock_Init for the width +8 and height +0xc and copies it into the second (0x8b dwords), stores them at +0x40 and +0x44, zeroes +0x34, +0x38 and +0x3c, sets bit 0 of +0 and returns 1. Returns 0 when already open or when the driver refuses. ES2's GLDisplay_Open (DBSIM 00480f1c).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0006a480; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 00480f1c

entries.name: Raster_SelectRenderTarget
entries.description: (display), callee-cleaned: makes display the current one (GL slot 7, 000bdd28) and installs it: when a display is current, GL_SetGlobal(0, 7), which always returns 0, so the early return of 1 never runs; GL_SetGlobal(display, 7); Raster_InstallDriverTable(+0x30); copies +4..+0x2c to 00098da2..00098dca; calls the driver's routines at 0009df1c, 0009df14 and 0009df18 with +0x34, +0x38 and +0x3c; Raster_InstallViewport(+0x40); Raster_SetClipBlock(+0x44); returns 0. ES2's Raster_SelectRenderTarget (DBSIM 00481118). Its one caller found by es2_xref is Sim_CreateDisplay.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0006a644; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 00481118; es2_xref caller

entries.name: Raster_DriverByName
entries.description: (unused, name) in stack order: the display driver number for a name, matching it whole against the table 0009b4e4: VGA_8 1, VGA_4 0, BMP_8 3; 4, the table's end, for any other name.

entries.name: GLDisplay_GetAttribute
entries.description: (display, which), callee-cleaned: ES2's GLDisplay_GetAttribute (DBSIM 00481244) statement for statement: 0 +8 (width), 1 +0xc (height), 2 +0x28, 3 +0x2c, 4 +0x10, 6 +0x14, 7 +0x18, 9 +0x1c, 10 +0x20, 11 +0x24, 5, 8 and 16 three globals, anything else 0.

entries.name: Raster_BlitDispatch
entries.description: (header, point, flags) in stack order: draws a bitmap at point on the canvas 00098d64, the point moved by the canvas's +0x20c/+0x210 less +0x21c/+0x220 when its +0x208 is 1. A bitmap of type 1 (low four bits of header byte +5) goes to 0007d66c; otherwise, by the canvas's +0x204: 0 the driver blit at 0009df3c(header, point, 0, flags), 1, or 2 with a positive canvas +0, the driver's clipped blit at 0009df44(header, point, canvas + 0x20c, flags). The point Bitmap_Blit (00067048) draws through.

entries.name: FileRWStream_CtorDefault
entries.description: FileRWStream() constructor, callee-cleaned (this): allocates 0xb bytes when this is null (0 if that fails), Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 0009b576 at +4, handle -1 at +8, status 5 and +0xa (owns the handle) cleared. ES2's FileRWStream_Ctor (DBSIM 0047a810).

entries.name: FileRWStream_CtorFromHandle
entries.description: FileRWStream(handle) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0xb bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 0009b576, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0xa = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR), FileRWStream_SetIoError on -1. ES2's FileRWStream_CtorFromHandle (DBSIM 0047a844).

entries.name: FileRWStream_Ctor
entries.description: FileRWStream(path) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0xb bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 0009b576, handle -1, +0xa cleared, then FileRWStream_Open(path). ES2's FileRWStream_CtorFromPath (DBSIM 0047a88c).

entries.name: FileRWStream_Dtor
entries.description: FileRWStream destructor (this, flags), vtable slot +4: restores the vtable 0009b576, FileRWStream_Close, Stream_BaseDtor(this, 0), and operator_delete when bit 0 of the flags is set. ES2's FileRWStream_Dtor (DBSIM 0047a8c4).

entries.name: FileRWStream_GetCapabilities
entries.description: FileRWStream vtable slot +0x10 (stream, query): queries 0 to 3 answer 1, anything else 0. ES2's FileRWStream_GetCapabilities (DBSIM 0047a900).

entries.name: FileRWStream_SetFile
entries.description: (stream, handle): FileRWStream_Close, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0xa = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR): status 0 on success, FileRWStream_SetIoError on -1. ES2's FileRWStream_SetFile (DBSIM 0047a92c).

entries.name: FileRWStream_Close
entries.description: (stream): closes the handle at +8 when the stream owns it (+0xa) and it is not -1, returning 0 with status 3 when close fails; otherwise sets the handle to -1 and status 5 and returns 1. ES2's FileRWStream_Close (DBSIM 0047a970).

entries.name: FileRWStream_Open
entries.description: (stream, path): FileRWStream_Close, then open(path, 0x102, 0x180) into the handle at +8, read-write, created when missing: status 1 and 0 returned on failure, else status 0, +0xa (owns the handle) set and 1 returned. ES2's FileRWStream_Open (DBSIM 0047a9b0).

entries.name: FileRWStream_Tell

entries.name: RLERStream_Read
entries.description: RLERStream vtable slot +0x1c (stream, buffer, count): 0 when the status is nonzero, 1 for a count of 0; otherwise run-length decodes count bytes from the source +8 and returns 1. A control byte with bit 7 set is a run of (control & 0x7f) copies of the byte after it (the byte +0xc, the remaining run +0xd); one with bit 7 clear is that many literal bytes, read from the source as many at a time as the count allows (remaining +0xe). The decoded count +0x8e advances by every byte out and by one more for each run's value byte. Every source read goes through the source's slot +0x1c, and a failed one copies the source's status and returns 0. ES2's RLERStream_Read (DBSIM 0047b5f8).

entries.name: fflush
entries.description: The runtime's fflush (stream), C convention: a null stream flushes every FILE with flushall and returns 0. Otherwise, for a buffered stream in write mode (flags +0xc & 0x26 == 2) with a buffer (+8) it writes the pending bytes (+0 less the buffer) to the handle +0x10, setting the error bit 0x20 on a short write, resets the pointer +0 to the buffer and the count +4 to the size +0x14; any other stream gets a count of 0. Returns -1 when the error bit is set, else 0.

entries.description: (script, ticks) in stack order, callee-cleaned: notes the default render context 0009f248 and, when the script's +0x1bd is not 0, sets 0009f248 to it and installs it with Raster_InstallRenderContext. Subtracts ticks from the wait +0x182. While it is above 0: unless the mode dword +0xe is 2, runs the page byte +1 with TtmScript_RunPage (0007aa58). Otherwise: when the byte +0x18a is 1 subtracts ticks from +0x186 and, below 0, reloads it from +0x188 and calls TtmScript_CyclePalette (00079d90); reloads the wait from +0x184; then through the table 0009f2f4 by mode: 0 runs the page, then takes the page +0x178 when it is not -1 (setting it to -1) or else adds 1 to the page and clears the byte +0x12, and when the page has reached the count byte +0 resets the script with TtmScript_Reset (0007ca44) and sets the mode to 0 when the loop dword +0x13 is 1, to 2 otherwise; 1 runs the page; 3 resets and sets the mode as at the end; 2 does nothing. entries.description: (script, a, b, name) in stack order, callee-cleaned: loads a .TTM. Opens TtmScript_BuildPath (00079b54)'s path with VolRStream_CtorFromPath and returns 3 when its status is not 0; TtmScript_FindTag (0007cba4) PAG:, reads the size dword and one byte, the page count's low byte; TT3:, reads the size dword and the method byte, returning 2 unless it is 1, then the unpacked length; allocates it at +6 (1 when that fails) and reads it through an RLERStream on the file stream, returning 1 when the file stream's status is then not 0. Loads, frees, palette selects, 0x0020, 0x4204, 0x4214, 0x2402, 0x0400, 0xf01f and 0x4124 act while the wait +0x182 is 0 or less; 0x1021 and 0x2022 act once per page through the byte +0x12, 0x2022 as min + labs(rand (0007cd28)() % (max - min)); 0x4114 acts on every run. entries.name: LZHuffman_Ctor
entries.description: LZHuffman constructor, callee-cleaned (this): allocates 0x16 bytes through operator_new when this is null (0 if that fails), then through operator_new the frequency table +4 (0x4e8 bytes), the parent links +8 (0x75a) and the child links +0xc (0x4e6), LZHUF's sizes for 314 symbols and a 627-node tree. The class stores no vptr. ES2's LZHuffman_Ctor (DBSIM 0047bb50).

entries.name: LZHuffman_Dtor
entries.description: LZHuffman destructor (this, flags): returns at once for a null this; otherwise operator_delete on the tables +4, +8 and +0xc, and on this when bit 0 of the flags is set. ES2's LZHuffman_Dtor (DBSIM 0047bb90).

entries.name: LZHuffman_Start
entries.description: (coder, source): attaches the source at +0, clears the bit-input state +0x10..+0x15, and builds LZHUF's initial tree: 314 (0x13a) leaves of frequency 1 (frequencies +4) whose child links (+0xc) are 0x273 + i and parent links (+8, from +0x4e6) their node, then the internal nodes 0x13a..0x272 each summing a pair, the sentinel frequency 0xffff at node 0x273 and parent 0 for the root 0x272. LZHUF's StartHuff. ES2's LZHuffman_Start (DBSIM 0047bbd0).

entries.name: LZHuffman_EncodeChar
entries.description: (coder, c): walks the parent links (+8, leaf c's at +0x4e6) up to the root 0x272, shifting each node's low bit into the code from the top, then LZHuffman_PutCode(coder, code, bit count) and LZHuffman_Update(coder, c). LZHUF's EncodeChar. ES2's LZHuffman_EncodeChar (DBSIM 0047bc80).

entries.name: LZHuffman_EncodePosition
entries.description: (coder, position): LZHuffman_PutCode with the code 000a7cd0[position >> 6] << 8 and the length 000a7c90[position >> 6] (LZHUF's p_code and p_len), then the low six bits << 10 in 6 bits. LZHUF's EncodePosition. ES2's LZHuffman_EncodePosition (DBSIM 0047bcd4).

entries.name: LZHuffman_DecodeChar
entries.description: (coder): walks the child links (+0xc) from the root (+0x4e4) one LZHuffman_GetBit at a time until a leaf (>= 0x273), LZHuffman_Update's it and returns leaf - 0x273. LZHUF's DecodeChar. ES2's LZHuffman_DecodeChar (DBSIM 0047bd18).

entries.name: LZHuffman_DecodePosition
entries.description: (coder): reads a byte with LZHuffman_GetByte, takes the upper six bits from 000a7d10 and the bit count from 000a7e10 (LZHUF's d_code and d_len), shifts count - 2 more bits from LZHuffman_GetBit into the byte from below and returns its low six bits | upper << 6, a 12-bit position. LZHUF's DecodePosition. ES2's LZHuffman_DecodePosition (DBSIM 0047bd68).

entries.name: LZHuffman_EncodeEnd
entries.description: (coder): writes the top byte of the bit buffer (+0x13) when bits are pending (+0x15), then a zero byte, each through the stream's slot +0x18. LZHUF's EncodeEnd with a trailing 0. ES2's LZHuffman_EncodeEnd (DBSIM 0047bdbc).

entries.name: LZHuffman_GetBit
entries.description: (coder): while the bit count +0x12 is below 9, reads a byte through the source's slot +0x1c (0 when the read fails), ORs it into the 16-bit buffer +0x10 below the bits held and adds 8 to the count; then shifts out and returns the top bit. LZHUF's GetBit. ES2's LZHuffman_GetBit (DBSIM 0047bdec).

entries.name: LZHuffman_GetByte
entries.description: (coder): LZHuffman_GetBit's refill, then shifts out and returns the top 8 bits. LZHUF's GetByte. ES2's LZHuffman_GetByte (DBSIM 0047be4c).

entries.name: LZHuffman_PutCode
entries.description: (coder, code, length) in stack order: ORs the code, shifted right by the pending bit count +0x15, into the output buffer +0x13 and adds length to the count; at 8 bits or more writes the buffer's top byte through the stream's slot +0x18, and when 8 still remain its low byte too and keeps code << (length - count). LZHUF's Putcode. ES2's LZHuffman_PutCode (DBSIM 0047beac).

entries.name: LZHuffman_Reconstruct
entries.description: (coder): rebuilds the adaptive Huffman tree: gathers the leaves (child link above 0x272) to the front with their frequencies (+4) halved, rounding up, rebuilds the internal nodes 0x13a..0x272 in frequency order with memmove, and relinks the parents (+8). LZHUF's reconst. ES2's LZHuffman_Reconstruct (DBSIM 0047bf20).

entries.name: LZHuffman_Update
entries.description: (coder, c): LZHuffman_Reconstruct when the root frequency (+4 at 0x4e4) is 0x8000, then increments the frequencies from leaf c up to the root, swapping a node past its lower-frequency successors to keep the order, with their child and parent links. LZHUF's update. ES2's LZHuffman_Update (DBSIM 0047c054).

entries.name: VGA8_BlitBitmap
entries.description: (header, point, clip, flags) in stack order: the VGA_8 driver's bitmap blit, its table's +0x68: clips the bitmap's rows (+0) and columns (+2) against clip when clip is non-null, mirrors by flags bits 1 and 2, and writes the bytes to display memory through the sequencer's map mask (ports 3c4/3c5) a plane at a time. With header byte +5's bit 4 set every byte is written; with it clear a 0 byte is skipped, leaving the pixel.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM disassembly at 0008b9a8 (head, clip, flag tests and copy loops)

entries.name: VGA8_BlitBitmapClipped
entries.description: (header, point, clip, flags), C convention: the VGA_8 driver's clipped blit, its table's +0x70 (0009df44): with clip non-null trims the bitmap's columns and rows to the rect clip (returning when nothing is left), picks the start and the row and column steps by flags bits 1 and 2, and draws each destination row with VGA8_BlitClippedRow, a plane at a time. With header byte +5's bit 4 set every byte is written; with it clear a 0 byte is skipped (OR AL,AL / JZ at 0008c58b).

entries.name: VGA8_BlitClippedRow
entries.description: A block of VGA8_BlitBitmapClipped, near-called with its frame (EBP) per destination row ([EBP-0x38]): in clip mode +0x204 2 clips the row to each region of the clip block's list in turn, a type-0 rect or a type-2 span region, passing over regions of other types; otherwise draws it once. For each of the four planes writes that plane's pixels of the row, every byte when header bit 4 is set, and only the non-zero ones when it is clear.

entries.name: BMP8_BlitBitmap
entries.description: The BMP_8 driver's bitmap blit, its table's +0x68: copies the bitmap's rows into the canvas bitmap, by flag bits 1 and 2 in one of four orders (cases 0-3). With header byte +5's bit 4 set each row goes by REP MOVSD/MOVSB, or byte by byte when mirrored; with it clear each 0 byte is skipped, leaving the destination. The clipped blit 0008dc3c calls it.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM disassembly at 0008d700 (the case blocks and copy loops)

entries.description: Seven int32 {75, 60, 45, 25, 18, 12, 6}, the address MechType_InitOne stores at every chassis record's +0xca. ES2's g_ShapeDetailThresholds (DBSIM 0049a344), with the same values.

entries.name: DamageScaleByDifficulty
entries.description: Four int16, 2800, 2000, 1400 and 1000: the Q10 factors Damage_ScaleByDifficulty (0001f82c) indexes by script.dat header word 7, or by 3 when the header word at offset 4 is not 0. ES2's DamageScaleBySide0Difficulty (DBSIM 0049a73c) holds 3500, 2800, 2100 and 1400, and ES2 has a second table for the other side.

entries.name: Terrain_TheaterNames
entries.description: Four string pointers indexed by the theater, header word 0 of data\script.dat: 0 desert, 1 temper, 2 ice, 3 urban. Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238) names dgs\<name> and dat\<name> by it. ES1GO's ShellMap_TheaterNames (0007e228) has the order temper, ice, desert, urban.

entries.name: ObjList_Count
entries.description: int16: the number of objects in ObjList_Objects (000bc58e). ObjList_Add (00020d5c) stores at it and increments it; ObjList_RebuildFrame (00020de0) resets it to ObjList_ZoneShapeCount (000bc596).

entries.name: ObjProbe_Armed
entries.description: byte: set by ObjProbe_Arm (0002125c) and cleared by ObjProbe_TestCorners (0002146c); while it is set ObjList_DrawEntryRender (00020f40) and ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) run the probe's steps, and ObjProbe_IsIdle (000213d0) answers 0.

entries.name: ObjList_SortEye
entries.description: The camera ObjList_SetSortEye (00021554) stores for the sort's comparisons.

entries.name: ObjList_SortNodes
entries.description: Pointer to the 0x1d-byte sort nodes ObjList_AllocSortNodes (00021560) allocates; ObjList_SortAndDraw (00021d04) draws the tree from the first. ObjList_FreeSortNodes (000215c8) frees them. ES2's ObjList_SortNodes (DBSIM 0049ac40).

entries.name: CockpitViewShakeArmed
entries.description: byte: set by CockpitView_SetShakeBand (000243d4) and cleared by CockpitView_ClearShake (00024750); CockpitView_StepShake (00024564), CockpitView_ClearShake and CockpitView_ApplyViewState (000222c0) test it. ES2's CockpitViewShakeArmed.

entries.name: CockpitShakeReseedAfterSlide
entries.description: byte: CockpitView_ApplyViewState (000222c0) sets it when a view change clears an armed shake and clears it on a change to view 4; CockpitView_StepViewTransition (00022904) then calls CockpitView_SetShakeBand (000243d4)(10). ES2's CockpitShakeReseedAfterSlide.

entries.name: CockpitPaletteSingleton
entries.description: dword: the dpl\cockpit palette CockpitViewManager_Ctor (00021dd4) loads while it is 0; CockpitViewManager_LoadViews (00021fb0) installs the scheme's colours from its +8 and calls its slot +0x1c. ES2's CockpitPaletteSingleton.

entries.name: CockpitOverride_Index
entries.description: int16: the chassis index CockpitChassis_SelectByName (00024394) stores for the -C option; CockpitViewManager_Ctor (00021dd4) takes it as the scheme word while CockpitOverride_Name is set. ES2's CockpitOverride_Index.

entries.name: CockpitOverride_Name
entries.description: char *: the -C option's text, stored by CockpitChassis_SelectByName (00024394); when it is set CockpitViewManager_Ctor (00021dd4) takes it in place of the chassis name. ES2's CockpitOverride_Name.

entries.name: g_TheaterHzline
entries.description: Pointer to the theater's hzline, built by Hzline_Ctor (00026180) in World_LoadTheater (000251c4). ES2's g_TheaterHzline (DBSIM 0049aee0).

entries.name: World_Clouds
entries.description: Pointer to the 0x113-byte object World_LoadTheater (000251c4) builds with TexPoly_Ctor (000271c0) and the vptr 000928f6 when the world file's second string is not empty; left as it was otherwise.

entries.name: World_PointScatter
entries.description: Pointer to the PointScatter_Ctor (00026dec) object World_LoadTheater (000251c4) builds when the world file's point count is not 0, its +0x15 set to the file's short 8; left as it was otherwise.

entries.name: World_FlatSetSelector
entries.description: int16: the world file's short 9, which World_LoadTheater (000251c4) passes to FlatObj_LoadResources (00006cf8): 0 loads dts\flat, anything else dts\flat2. ES2's World_FlatSetSelector (DBSIM 0049aeea).

entries.name: ImpactPaletteObject
entries.description: The palette World_LoadTheater (000251c4) loads from dpl\<the world file's third string> with Palette_LoadDpl when the string is not empty, impact1 in every retail file. ES2's ImpactPaletteObject.

entries.name: ActivePaletteObject
entries.description: The live palette object, ES2's ActivePaletteObject (DBSIM 0049b020): +4 its int16 entry count, +8 its entries. Palette_LoadAndActivate (00027e5c) and Palette_SetActive (00027e7c) set it.

entries.name: Palette_LastUploaded
entries.description: The palette Palette_FlushDirtyRange (00027f74) last uploaded whole; it uploads the active palette whole when that differs.

entries.name: Palette_DirtyFirst
entries.description: int32: the first entry of the dirty range Palette_InstallRange (00027e98) and Palette_StepCrossFade (000287a8) widen and Palette_FlushDirtyRange (00027f74) sends and clears.

entries.name: Palette_DirtyLast
entries.description: int32: the last entry of the dirty range (Palette_DirtyFirst (00092c28)).

entries.name: Palette_DirtyValid
entries.description: byte: set while the dirty range holds entries; Palette_FlushDirtyRange (00027f74) clears it.

entries.name: g_ShadeRamps
entries.description: Pointer to the 21 8-byte shade ramp records {int16 *indices, int16 count} Palette_LoadResources (00027e10) allocates, each with 21 int16 indices; Palette_SetRampsToRange (00028044) and Palette_SetRampsToRangeList (000280e4) fill them. ES2's g_ShadeRamps (DBSIM 0049b034) holds 0x81.

entries.name: PaletteFade_EndTime
entries.description: The clock value (the dword 000981c4) at which the cross fade ends, which Palette_StepCrossFade (000287a8) sets on its first call after Palette_BeginCrossFade (00028528).

entries.name: PaletteFade_Armed
entries.description: byte: set while PaletteFade_EndTime (00092c38) holds the running fade's end; Palette_BeginCrossFade clears it.

entries.name: SquadSlotColors
entries.description: Four int16, 56, 59, 49 and 0: HudColorTable_Get (0002e2e4) returns entry i. Where ES2's holds ids at 0049b040 that it maps through HudColorTable.

entries.name: CockpitViewInstance
entries.description: Pointer to the cockpit view object. Cockpit_PushCanvasContext installs its +4, the cockpit's render context; CockpitView_RectCornerVisible tests its byte +0x20b and reads that context's origin. ES2's CockpitViewInstance (DBSIM 0049b088).

entries.name: Cockpit_CursorImages
entries.description: The seven .DCI cursors ColorSchemePanels_LoadAll (0002aecc) loads from dci, in the order of the name table 00092e24: cursor, pcursor, mcursor, ncursor, scursor, ecursor, wcursor. ES2's Cockpit_CursorImages (DBSIM 0049b08c).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0002aecc and the name table 00092e24

entries.name: CockpitGauRecord
entries.description: Pointer to the cockpit's .GAU struct, which Cockpit_LoadPanel (0002c9d8) stores from Gau_Load (0002b5c4); the weapon-row gauge factories copy their rects out of it. ES2's CockpitGauRecord (DBSIM 0049b0a8).

entries.name: ColorSchemePanels
entries.description: The ten fonts ColorSchemePanels_LoadAll (0002aecc) loads from dfn, in the order of the name table 00092dc4: cpblue, cpgreen, cpred, cpylw, cpon, cppress, cpoff, cpgrey, cpblack, cporange. ES2's ColorSchemePanels (DBSIM 0049b0ac) holds 18.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0002aecc and the name table 00092dc4

entries.name: CockpitPButtonsBank
entries.description: The bitmap bank dba\pbuttons, which ColorSchemePanels_LoadAll (0002aecc) loads with ClassItem_LoadFromFile while this is 0.

entries.name: CockpitSquadGroup
entries.description: The player's mission group, which Cockpit_LoadSquadmatePilots (0002b308) stores and Squad_BroadcastOrderFromCockpit (0002b448) hands Squad_BroadcastOrder. ES2's 0049b0f8.

entries.name: CockpitTtmManager
entries.description: The cockpit's .TTM manager, which Cockpit_LoadPanel (0002c9d8) makes with Ttm_ManagerCtor (00069540)(0, 0, the installed render context, 10), gives the prefix ttm\ and two handles, and runs with Ttm_RunAll.

entries.name: HitShakeEndTick
entries.description: Dword: the value of the counter 000981c4 at which the hit shake ends, 0 while none runs. Cockpit_StartHitShake (0002e17c) sets it; Cockpit_HitShakeTick (0002e1d8) clears it at the end or in view 4. ES2's HitShakeEndTick.

entries.name: HitShakeNextToggleTick
entries.description: Dword: the value of the counter 000981c4 after which Cockpit_HitShakeTick (0002e1d8) next flips the impact palette, 0 while the shake is disarmed; Cockpit_StartHitShake (0002e17c) arms it. ES2's HitShakeNextToggleTick.

entries.name: Cockpit_SkipFrameDraw
entries.description: Byte: Cockpit_DrawFrame (0002cf28) returns at once while it is set. es2_xref finds two writes, both in 00057820, which sets it to 1 for one Sim_RenderFrame and Sim_EndFrame between two CockpitView_SetView calls and clears it before a second Sim_RenderFrame.

entries.name: CockpitContextStackIndex
entries.description: Byte, 0xff in the image: the index Cockpit_PushCanvasContext (0002b00c) raises before saving the installed render context in CockpitContextStack (000b0df4) and Cockpit_PopRenderContext (0002b03c) lowers after reinstalling it.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0002b00c and 0002b03c; image byte at 00092d7d

entries.name: CockpitView_DeviceButtonLatch
entries.description: Byte: the view device's button byte +0xb as CockpitView_PollViewDevice (0002d1a0) last saw it, so that a press acts once. ES2's 0049b550.

entries.name: CockpitWidgets_CommandCodes
entries.description: 24 dwords, the codes CockpitWidgets_HandleCommand (0002d24c) answers: 0, 2-10, 0x3b-0x44, 1, 0x0f, 0x57 and 0x13; then, at 00092f94, their 24 handler addresses inside CockpitWidgets_HandleCommand.

entries.description: The screen-edge strip's vtable: CTLButtonControlVtablePanelCopy (0009301e) with the click slot +0xc ScrollTrigger_OnClick (0002db04), entered through 0002db03. CockpitView_BuildScrollTriggers (0002d970) stores it at each strip's +0x1c. ES2's ScrollTriggerVtable.

entries.name: MessagePort_ShowEnabled
entries.description: Byte, 1 in the image: MessagePort_Tick (0002ef58) calls a port's show only while it is set, otherwise counting a due and ready message as shown. MessageTicker_Update (0002fab8) sets it to 1 around the ticker's tick; the frameless code at 0004ad30 stores (value != 1) in it.

entries.name: DialogPortVtable

entries.description: 34 jump targets, for ids 0 to 0x21, of MessagePort_Show (0002f96c)'s tone switch.

entries.name: PaperDoll_TypeTable

entries.name: PanelGaugeVtable

entries.description: BarGraphH's vtable, which BarGraphH_Ctor stores at a bar's +0x28: a zero dword, then BarGraphH_PaintToValue (000317c4), BarGraphH_RepaintSpan (000318e0) and BarGraphH_ResetToEmpty (000317a4) by its padding. ES2's BarGraphH table (DBSIM 0049bd60).

entries.name: BarGraphVVtable
entries.description: BarGraphV's vtable, which BarGraphV_Ctor stores at a bar's +0x28: a zero dword, then BarGraphV_PaintToValue (00031b30), BarGraphV_RepaintSpan (00031c54) and BarGraphV_ResetToEmpty (00031b10) by its padding. ES2's BarGraphV table (DBSIM 0049bd48).

entries.name: LEDBarGraphHVtable
entries.description: LEDBarGraphH's vtable, which LedBarGraph_Ctor (00031e28) stores at a bar's +0x28: a zero dword, then LedBarGraph_PaintToValue (00031e5c), LedBarGraph_RepaintToValue (00031fac) and BarGraphH_ResetToEmpty (000317a4). ES2's LEDBarGraphHVtable (DBSIM 0049bd30).

entries.name: LEDBarGraphVVtable
entries.description: LEDBarGraphV's vtable, which LEDBarGraphV_Ctor (0003216c) stores at a bar's +0x28: a zero dword, then LedBarGraphV_PaintToValue (000321a0), LedBarGraphV_Repaint (000322f4) and BarGraphV_ResetToEmpty (00031b10). ES2's LEDBarGraphVVtable (DBSIM 0049bd18).

entries.name: LEDBMBarGraphHVtable
entries.description: LEDBMBarGraphH's vtable, which LedBmBarGraphH_Ctor (000324e4) stores at a bar's +0x28: a zero dword, then LedBmBarGraphH_PaintToValue (00032764), LedBmBarGraphH_RepaintNoOp (00032833) and BarGraphH_ResetToEmpty (000317a4). ES2's LEDBMBarGraphHVtable (DBSIM 0049bd00).

entries.name: LEDBMBarGraphVVtable
entries.description: LEDBMBarGraphV's vtable, which LedBmBarGraphV_Ctor (00032a18) stores at a bar's +0x28: a zero dword, then LedBmBarGraphV_PaintToValue (00032c1c), LedBmBarGraphV_RepaintNoOp (00032ced) and BarGraphV_ResetToEmpty (00031b10). ES2's LEDBMBarGraphVVtable (DBSIM 0049bce8).

entries.name: MfdStatus_BasesBank
