entries.name: MfdMissileView_TrackedRound
entries.description: The round the MISSILE CAM screen follows, or 0: MfdMissileViewScreen_Paint (000364f8) walks the pool 000af0b4 for it and clears it when it is gone, and MfdMissileViewScreen_Update (000368cc) repaints the screen while it is set. es2_xref finds one store besides the paint's, at 00007843 in 00007748. ES2's 0049c394.
entries.source: es2_xref.py --binary ES1DBSIM 00093914; grep of ES1DBSIM_disasm_full.txt for 0x93914

entries.name: MFDMissileViewVtable
entries.description: MFDMissileView's vtable, which MfdMissileViewScreen_Ctor (000360c0) stores at a screen's +8: a zero dword, then MfdMissileViewScreen_Paint (000364f8) and MfdMissileViewScreen_Update (000368cc), each by its padding. ES2's MFDMissileViewVtable.
entries.source: es1_naming.py vtables ES1DBSIM; the image at 0009391a

entries.name: MFDNavMapVtable
entries.description: MFDNavMap's vtable, which MfdMapScreen_Ctor (00036b18) stores at a screen's +8: a zero dword, then MfdMapScreen_PaintNoOp (00036c28) and MfdMapScreen_Paint by its padding 00036c2b. ES2's MFDNavMapVtable.
entries.source: es1_naming.py vtables ES1DBSIM; the image at 000939f2

entries.name: WeaponGaugeVtable
entries.description: The weapon row gauge base's vtable, which WeaponGauge_Ctor (00036f50) stores at +0x76 and EnergyWeaponGauge_Ctor (0003700c) and AmmoWeaponGauge_Ctor (000373a4) store again: a zero dword, then PanelGauge_OnChildClickNoOpWeaponGaugeCopy (00036f85), 0, 0, PanelGauge_KeyDispatchNoneWeaponGaugeCopy (00036f8b) and WeaponGauge_SetStateNoOp (00036f91). ES2's ChainedWeaponGaugeVtable one slot further on.
entries.source: es1_naming.py vtables ES1DBSIM; the image at 00093a6e

entries.name: EnergyWeaponGaugeVtable
entries.description: The energy row's vtable: a zero dword, then EnergyWeaponGauge_OnChildClick (000372e4), EnergyWeaponGauge_Paint (00037144), EnergyWeaponGauge_Update (0003716c), the key slot at 00036f8c and EnergyWeaponGauge_SetState (00037194), the last three by their padding. ES2's EnergyWeaponGaugeVtable.
entries.source: es1_naming.py vtables ES1DBSIM; the image at 00093a8e

entries.name: ProjectileWeaponGaugeVtable
entries.description: The ammunition row's vtable: a zero dword, then AmmoWeaponGauge_OnChildClick (00037784), AmmoWeaponGauge_Paint (00037544), AmmoWeaponGauge_Update (000375e4), the key slot at 00036f8c and AmmoWeaponGauge_SetState (000376b4), the paint, update and set-state by their padding. ES2's ProjectileWeaponGaugeVtable.
entries.source: es1_naming.py vtables ES1DBSIM; the image at 00093aae

entries.name: VolumeGroup_BufferSize
entries.description: dword: the buffer size VolumeGroup_AddVolume passes Volume_LoadVolume (00055dc8) for each volume it loads. 0x400 in the image; VolumeGroup_Ctor stores 0x400 and VolumeGroup_SetBufferSize its argument, at least 0x80. ES2's VolumeGroup_BufferSize (DBSIM 004a08a4).

entries.name: g_VolumeGroup
entries.description: The volume group VolRStream_Open looks a path up in when the path does not open as a file: made by VolRStream_SetGroup, filled by VolRStream_LoadVolume and deleted by VolRStream_DeleteGroup. ES2's g_VolumeGroup (DBSIM 004a0d30).

entries.name: errno
entries.description: int: the last DOS error. The error exit read and open share (00074922) stores it; VolRStream_SetIoError and FileRStream_SetIoError read it.

entries.name: FrameRate_Best
entries.description: Two int16, whole then hundredths: the highest rate FrameRate_Update has measured, from 0.00. FrameRate_Worst follows at FrameRate_Worst (00097f5c), from 999.99.

entries.name: FrameRate_Worst
entries.description: Two int16, whole then hundredths: the lowest rate FrameRate_Update has measured, from 999.99.

entries.name: g_RasterRoutines
entries.description: The rasterizer's 36 function pointers, zero in the image, followed by the count 0x24 at 0009df64. Raster_DrawLine calls slots 0, 1 and 34, Raster_FillRect slots 0, 2 and 3, and Widget_DrawToCockpit slots 16, 17, 30 and 31. ES2's g_RasterRoutines (DBSIM 004a57c4), whose slots have those uses.

entries.name: _iob
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `_iob`, the stdio FILE array, 0x18 bytes per FILE with the flags at +0xc and the DOS handle at +0x10: stdin (handle 0, flags 0x101) at 0009e84c, stdout (handle 1, 0x102) at 0009e864, stderr (handle 2, 0x106) at 0009e87c and handle 3 (0x180) at 0009e894. vprintf writes to stdout.

entries.name: g_TSObjectTypeRegistry
entries.description: The shape class registry: 18 entries of 12 bytes {tag, load function, name}, followed at 0009f080 by their count, 0x12. Light_ResetSystem (000632ec) registers it with ClassItem_RegisterBucket. ES2's g_TSObjectTypeRegistry (DBSIM 004a63c8), with the same tags, names and order.

entries.name: g_BasePool
entries.description: Pointer to the pool DBSim_BuildGroupRecord (0001cff4) takes a base group's members and a kind-3 target from with Pool_Nth (00063a78); each such member goes to FUN_000044a4 with the group.

entries.name: g_ExplosionPool
entries.description: The impact-effect pool, Pool_Init(0, 0x51, 0x28) in Explosion_LoadResources (00005764): 40 effects of 0x51 bytes. ES2's g_ExplosionPool.

entries.name: WeaponMount_ShotTransform
entries.description: The shot transform WeaponMount_PrepareShot (0000add4) builds, its translation at 000af158, which the beam dispatches overwrite with WeaponMount_ShotMuzzlePoint (000af164) before passing it to 000088cc. ES2's 004a98b8.

entries.name: WeaponMount_ShotMuzzlePoint
entries.description: The muzzle's world point WeaponMount_PrepareShot (0000add4) stores, passed to the fire dispatches' shot functions. ES2's 004a98d8.

entries.name: WeaponMount_ShotEuler
entries.description: The firing angles WeaponMount_PrepareShot (0000add4) extracts from the shot transform with Transform_RotationToEuler, passed to the fire dispatches' shot functions. ES2's 004a98e4.

entries.name: WeaponMount_DisplayNameBuffer
entries.description: The buffer WeaponMount_GetDisplayName (0000aa9c) builds a mount's name in and returns. ES2's 004a9954.

entries.name: WeaponTexBank
entries.description: Pointer to the dba\wpntex bitmap bank Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48) loads while g_LowMemory (000bda98) is 0; WeaponMount_ShapeForMountingCode (0000bd70) stores it at each weapon model's +0x26, and the loader at each mechwpn2 root's.

entries.name: WeaponMountTemplate_SideMuzzleOffsetInit
entries.description: Byte: WeaponMountTemplate_SideMuzzleOffset (0000bbd4) sets it to 1 when it is 0, the construction flag of its result vector WeaponMountTemplate_SideMuzzleOffsetVec (000af1f8).

entries.name: WeaponMountTemplate_SideMuzzleOffsetVec
entries.description: Three int16 x, y, z: the side muzzle offset WeaponMountTemplate_SideMuzzleOffset (0000bbd4) builds and returns. ES2's is at DBSIM 004a9b74.

entries.name: EnemySighted_CalledInLatch
entries.description: Byte array indexed by an object's int16 slot +0x45: Mech_AiEnemySighted (0000e760) sets an object's byte when the player's machine (+0x9d) sights it and when a squadmate's callout tests pass. ES2's EnemySighted_CalledInLatch (DBSIM 004a9b84).

entries.name: EnemySighted_CalloutRateLimit
entries.description: Countdown record, its int16 counter at 000af269: Mech_AiEnemySighted (0000e760) ticks it with Math_CountdownTimerTick (0006410c) on each call for a machine whose +0x9d is clear and stores 10000 in the counter on each callout. ES2's EnemySighted_CalloutRateLimit (DBSIM 004a9be8).

entries.name: BehaviourStateTable
entries.description: The 20 AI behaviour state descriptors, 0x28 bytes each, built at startup by Behaviour_BuildStateTable: +0 name, +4 dwell, +8 sixteen flag bytes (Behaviour_ExpandFlagBits), +0x18 think, +0x1c move and +0x20 reassess functions, +0x24 a dword of 0, 3, 5, 6 or 7. Reassess is 00016e04 for the five combat states and fleeing, none for player, in limbo, dead and disabled, and 0001892c for the rest; move is none for deciding and in limbo, 00018278 for ramming and 00014844 for the rest; think is none for deciding and in limbo and 00018308 for both dead and disabled. ES2's BehaviourStateTable (DBSIM 004993a4) holds 22 of 0x3e bytes with member-function triples.

entries.name: FlyerBehaviourStateTable
entries.description: The aircraft's seven behaviour state descriptors, 0x24 bytes each, filled at startup by Flyer_BuildStateTable (000105b0): +0 name, +4 dwell, +8 sixteen flag bytes, +0x18 think, +0x1c move, +0x20 reassess. ES2's FlyerBehaviourStateTable (DBSIM 00499cf8).

entries.name: g_MechPool
entries.description: Pointer to the mech pool: DBSim_BuildGroupRecord (0001cff4) takes a mech group's members and a kind-1 target from it with Pool_Nth (00063a78), and Mission_TotalSalvage (0001d434) walks it with Pool_Prev.

entries.name: g_FlyerPool
entries.description: Pointer to the pool DBSim_BuildGroupRecord (0001cff4) takes a flyer group's members and a kind-2 target from with Pool_Nth (00063a78); each such member goes to FUN_0001b574 with the group.

entries.name: MissionPollTimer
entries.description: The mission status poll's countdown record, its int16 counter a byte later (MissionPollTimer_Count (000af79d)), which Mission_PollStatus (0000f454) ticks and reloads with 10000. ES2's MissionPollTimer (DBSIM 004a9ee6).

entries.name: MissionPollTimer_Count
entries.description: int16: the counter of MissionPollTimer (000af79c), which Mission_PollStatus (0000f454) loads with 10000 when it raises nothing.

entries.name: MissionAlertTimer
entries.description: The mission status alert delay's countdown record, its int16 counter a byte later (MissionAlertTimer_Count (000af7a1)), which Mission_PollStatus (0000f454) ticks. ES2's MissionAlertTimer (DBSIM 004a9ee9).

entries.name: MissionAlertTimer_Count
entries.description: int16: the counter of MissionAlertTimer (000af7a0), which Mission_PollStatus (0000f454) loads with 10000 as it arms MissionAlertArmed (000bc4b0) and tests for 0 before raising a status.

entries.name: Mission_Box
entries.description: Four int32: the least X, least Y, greatest X and greatest Y of block 1's points, which DBSim_LoadScriptDat (0001d850) fills and Mission_IsOutsideBox (0000f6b8) tests against. ES2's Mission_Box (DBSIM 004aa6c4).

entries.name: RaycastShapeMinDistance
entries.description: dword: RaycastShapeMinDistance_Clear (00020880) zeroes it and RaycastShapeMinDistance_Get (0002088c) returns it, around Sim_RaycastObjectList's walk over the zone's shapes. Sim_RaycastShapeVolume (00020894) lowers it to an object's distance from the ray's start when that is less, and zeroes it for an object within reach; a distance is never negative, so after a clear these writes leave it 0. A grep of the disassembly for it by address finds these five accesses. ES2's RaycastShapeMinDistance (DBSIM 004aab54).

entries.name: ObjPick_Pending
entries.description: byte: set by ObjPick_Arm (00020d28), cleared by ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) after the draw it picks in; ObjPick_IsIdle (00020d50) answers whether it is 0.

entries.name: ObjPick_Point
entries.description: Two int32, the screen point of the pixel pick, which ObjPick_Arm (00020d28) copies in.

entries.name: ObjPick_Object
entries.description: The last object whose draw changed the pick's pixel, stored by ObjList_DrawEntryRender (00020f40); ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) zeroes it when a pick starts and ObjPick_GetObject (00020d48) returns it.

entries.name: ObjProbe_Corners
entries.description: Four 8-byte screen points, two int32 each, built by ObjList_RegisterSubsystem (00021518): the corners of the square ObjProbe_Arm (0002125c) sets around the probed object.

entries.name: ObjProbe_SavedPixels
entries.description: Four dwords: the pixels ObjProbe_MarkCorners (00021404) saves under the probe's corners, which ObjProbe_TestCorners (0002146c) writes back.

entries.name: ObjProbe_CornerFlags
entries.description: Four bytes, one per probe corner: 1 when ObjProbe_Arm (0002125c) finds the corner off the clip rect or ObjProbe_TestCorners (0002146c) finds it covered; ObjProbe_IsHidden (000213dc) adds them up.

entries.name: ObjProbe_Object
entries.description: The object ObjProbe_Arm (0002125c) probes; ObjList_DrawEntryRender (00020f40) calls ObjProbe_MarkCorners (00021404) after drawing it while ObjProbe_Armed (0009255a) is set.

entries.name: ObjPick_SavedPixel
entries.description: The pixel under ObjPick_Point (000afa48): saved by ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) before the draw, replaced by ObjList_DrawEntryRender (00020f40) with each pixel an object's draw leaves there, and written back by ObjList_DrawFrameObjects after the draw.

entries.name: ObjList_Blend
entries.description: int16: ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) stores its first argument here; ObjList_DrawEntryRender (00020f40) passes it to WorldShades_ApplyForObject (00025d44) and calls Light_ReregisterPersistent (00005690) when it is non-zero.

entries.name: CockpitViewCanvasOrigin
entries.description: Two int32: the current view's canvas origin, its .VUE record's +0x18/+0x1c, stored by CockpitView_ApplyViewState (000222c0) and zeroed for view 4; CockpitView_SetShakeBand (000243d4) rests the shake on it. ES2's 004cfa24.

entries.name: CockpitVueRecords
entries.description: Four 32-byte .VUE records, built by CockpitViewManager_StaticInit (00024c28) with CockpitVueRecord_ElementCtor (00024cc4); CockpitViewManager_LoadViews (00021fb0) reads vue\<name> into them and stores their address at the manager's +4. ES2's CockpitVueRecords (DBSIM 004cfa2c).

entries.name: ExternalView_DefaultRect
entries.description: Six int32, {0, 30, 319, 170, -160, -75}: the external view's rect and projection pair, set by CockpitViewManager_Ctor (00021dd4) with the cockpit palette's first load; ExternalView_ResetRect (00024a7c) copies it to ExternalView_Rect. ES2's ExternalView_DefaultRect.

entries.name: ExternalView_Rect
entries.description: Six int32: the external view's rect (left, top, right, bottom) and projection pair, which CockpitView_ApplyViewState (000222c0) installs for view 4 and View_FillOutside3dRect (00024b18) paints around; set by ExternalView_SetRect (00024a00) and ExternalView_ResetRect (00024a7c); ExternalView_GetRect (00024c20) returns its address. ES2's ExternalView_Rect.

entries.name: CockpitShakeRestOffset
entries.description: Two int32: the canvas origin CockpitView_SetShakeBand (000243d4) arms the shake at, x 0 in views 2 and 3; CockpitView_ClearShake (00024750) puts the pages' origins back on it. ES2's 004cfadc.

entries.name: CockpitShakeOffset
entries.description: Two int32: the shaken origin, set with CockpitShakeRestOffset by CockpitView_SetShakeBand (000243d4), its y moved by CockpitView_StepShake (00024564). ES2's 004cfae4.

entries.name: CockpitShakeBand
entries.description: Two int32, the low and high limits of the shaken origin's y, set by CockpitView_SetShakeBand (000243d4) and read by CockpitView_StepShake (00024564). ES2's 004cfaec.

entries.name: CockpitShakeTotal
entries.description: int16: the sum of CockpitView_StepShake (00024564)'s steps, zeroed by CockpitView_SetShakeBand (000243d4), taken back and zeroed by CockpitView_ClearShake (00024750), and returned as {0, total} by CockpitView_GetShakeOffset (000249d4). ES2's 004cfaf4.

entries.name: CockpitShakeStripRegion
entries.description: A 0x18-byte rect region (vtable 00092762 from CockpitViewManager_StaticInit (00024c28)) whose rect CockpitViewManager_Ctor (00021dd4) sets to {0, 200, 320, 210}: CockpitView_SetShakeBand (000243d4) saves and fills it in views 2 and 3 and CockpitView_ClearShake (00024750) restores it. ES2's 004cfafe.

entries.name: CockpitShakeStripPixels
entries.description: The buffer of Region_PixelCount bytes CockpitViewManager_Ctor (00021dd4) allocates, which holds CockpitShakeStripRegion's pixels while a glance's shake runs. ES2's 004cfb18.

entries.name: ExternalView_ClipBlock
entries.description: A 0x204-byte clip block, count 1 and ExternalView_ClipRegion's +4 (000afd9c), set by CockpitViewManager_LoadViews (00021fb0); CockpitView_ApplyViewState (000222c0) installs it for view 4. ES2's 004cfb1c.

entries.name: ExternalView_ClipRegion
entries.description: A 0x18-byte rect region (vtable 00092762 from CockpitViewManager_StaticInit (00024c28)) whose rect, at 000afda0, CockpitViewManager_LoadViews (00021fb0), ExternalView_SetRect (00024a00) and ExternalView_ResetRect (00024a7c) set to ExternalView_Rect's first four values.

entries.name: WorldShades_LevelRanges
entries.description: Pointer to rows x cols (int16 start, int16 count) ranges Palette_InterpolateIndexRanges (000289e0) expands from the world file's two range tables in World_LoadTheater (000251c4). ES2's WorldShades_LevelRanges (DBSIM 004cfd7c).

entries.name: WorldShades_BlendRanges
entries.description: Pointer to rows (int16 start, int16 count) ranges Palette_InterpolateIndexRanges (000289e0) expands from the world file's two single ranges in World_LoadTheater (000251c4). ES2's WorldShades_BlendRanges (DBSIM 004cfd80).

entries.name: WorldShades_BandsTagged
entries.description: Pointer to the world file's first int32 table, count at 000bc5b8, read by World_LoadTheater (000251c4). ES2's WorldShades_BandsTagged (DBSIM 004cfd84), the distance thresholds for an object with a type tag.

entries.name: WorldShades_BandsTag0
entries.description: Pointer to the world file's second int32 table, count at 000bc5ba, read by World_LoadTheater (000251c4). ES2's WorldShades_BandsTag0 (DBSIM 004cfd88), the thresholds for type tag 0.

entries.name: CockpitCanvasContext
entries.description: The cockpit's canvas render context, stored by Cockpit_CreateCanvasContext (0002ad78). ES2's 004d042c.

entries.name: Cockpit_ZeroOffset
entries.description: Two int32, the offset Widget_DrawToCockpit (0002b058) copies at when given none; panel.cpp's static initializer at Cockpit_StaticInit (0002e404) stores 0 in both. ES2's Cockpit_ZeroOffset (DBSIM 0049b07e).

entries.name: CockpitContextStack
entries.description: The dword stack of render contexts Cockpit_PushCanvasContext (0002b00c) saves, indexed by CockpitContextStackIndex (00092d7d). ES2's 004d0470.

entries.name: PilotStringTables
entries.description: Three 0x10-byte string tables, one per squadmate slot, holding str\pilot<n>.str: built by MessagePort_StaticInit (0002fe00), loaded by SystemMessages_Index (0002f1ec). ES2's PilotStringTables (DBSIM 004d0498).

entries.name: CommandStringTable
entries.description: The string table holding str\commandr.str, loaded by SystemMessages_Index (0002f1ec) for a slot whose squadmate is its group's first member. ES2's CommandStringTable (DBSIM 004d04c8) holds COMMAND<n>.STR.

entries.name: SystemStringTable
entries.description: The string table holding str\system.str, loaded by MessagePort_CtorBase (0002eb80) through SystemMessages_Index (0002f1ec) when it is empty. ES2's SystemStringTable (DBSIM 004d04d8).

entries.name: PilotMessagePort_LineBuffer
entries.description: The pilot channel's composed line, speaker, ": " and text, built by PilotMessagePort_ComposeLine (0002f454).

entries.name: MessagePort_TextBuffer
entries.description: The ticker's line, 0x50 characters at most, set by MessagePort_SetText (0002f934) and drawn by MessageTicker_Paint (0002fa00).

entries.name: SimStringTable
entries.description: The 0x10-byte string table SimStrings_LoadAll (0002fe84) loads str\strings0 into, built by SimStrings_StaticInit (000301d0) and freed by SimStrings_StaticDtor (000301dc). ES2's SimStringTable (DBSIM 004d131c).

entries.name: PaperDoll_WeaponIconBank
entries.description: dba\weapons, loaded by PaperDoll_InitTables (00030288) with ClassItem_LoadFromFile; PaperDoll_BuildWeaponIcons (0003058c) takes its frames from the bank's +8 array. ES2's DAT_004d1754.

entries.name: WeaponIconSizes
entries.description: 12 {int32 width, int32 height} pairs, built by PaperDoll_StaticInit (00030f00) and read from pdg\weapons by PaperDoll_InitTables (00030288); the retail file holds 12. PaperDoll_BuildWeaponIcons reads them by frame. ES2's WeaponIconSizes (DBSIM 004d1758), 28 pairs.

entries.name: PaperDoll_StaticWeaponIcons
entries.description: 17 0x22-byte weapon icons that PaperDoll_StaticInit (00030f00) builds with PaperDollWeaponIcon_ElementCtor (000307b0). es2_xref finds the address in PaperDoll_StaticInit alone; its reader is Open in the paper doll's doc.

entries.name: Label_Pen
entries.description: The labels' pen {x, y}, two dwords: Label_SetText sets it from the label's anchor and draws the text at it, and Label_SetTextWithHotkey adds the hotkey's offset to its x before drawing the hotkey's character at it.

entries.name: MfdMissileView_ClipRegion
entries.description: The GLRectangleRegion MfdMissileView_StaticInit (00036a20) builds: its vptr at +0 and +4 cleared. MfdMissileViewScreen_Ctor (000360c0) points the clip block 000b11c4's region at its +4, 000b13cc, and writes the viewport's rect at its +8 to +0x14, 000b13d0-000b13dc.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM disassembly at 00036a20; ES1DBSIM decompile at 000360c0

entries.name: MfdMapScreen_ViewAngles
entries.description: Three int16, {0xc000, 0, 0} from MfdMapScreen_StaticInit (00036e9c): the NAV MAP camera's orientation at construction, and the first word its paint copies into the camera's pitch. ES2's MfdMapScreen_ViewAngles (DBSIM 0049c454).

entries.name: Input_CursorPos
entries.description: The point Input_GetCursorPos (0004d910) returns, which Cockpit_PickEdgeCursor (0002dcc8) reads while the dword 000b5b76 is set. ES2's Input_CursorPos.

entries.name: ClassItem_CurrentFrame
entries.description: Pointer to the item frame of the class item being loaded: ClassItem_LoadResource points it at a frame on its stack and restores the previous value on exit. ES2's ClassItem_CurrentFrame (DBSIM 006c59e8).

entries.name: SimDisplay
entries.description: The display Sim_EndFrame (00059b40) flips each frame: +0x8c shown, +0x88 drawn, the two swapped.

entries.name: CockpitViewManagerInstance
entries.description: The cockpit view manager Sim_StartMission (0005a9dc) makes with CockpitViewManager_Ctor (00021dd4) and passes to CockpitViewManager_Publish (00021f8c); Sim_EndFrame (00059b40) passes it to CockpitView_StepViewTransition and CockpitView_ProcessViewCommand. ES2's CockpitViewManagerInstance (DBSIM 004d2544).

entries.name: LocalPlayerMech
entries.description: Pointer to the player's machine: 00059700 pushes it for Mission_PollStatus (0000f454), and Mission_IsClearOfThreats (0000f744) compares the subject's group with its group (+0x3f). ES2's LocalPlayerMech (DBSIM 004d256a).
entries.source: Herculan/docs/es1/simulation/mission-status.md#globals; ES1DBSIM disassembly at 00059a05 and decompile at 0000f744

entries.name: maybe_WeaponChain_EoHold
entries.description: int16: WeaponMounts_FireTrigger (0000d2bc) sets it to 1 when it fires a mount whose subtype slot +0x64 answers 3, the electro-optical missile; while it is set WeaponMounts_ChainReady (0000ce1c) answers ready without asking and WeaponMounts_PerFrameUpdate (0000cf78) does not step the selection. ES2's 004d25aa.

entries.name: maybe_WeaponChain_EoStepPending
entries.description: int16: WeaponMounts_FireTrigger (0000d2bc) sets it to 1 with maybe_WeaponChain_EoHold (000b5bc6); WeaponMounts_SetSelection (0000cb00) clears it when the selection changes; while it is set and maybe_WeaponChain_EoHold (000b5bc6) is clear, WeaponMounts_PerFrameUpdate (0000cf78) steps the selection and clears single fire. ES2's 004d25ac.

entries.name: Raster_WorldToView
entries.description: The installed camera's world-to-view transform (0x20 bytes), built by Raster_InstallViewProjection; the byte at 000b5e00 is its first-use flag. ES2's DBSIM 006c6018.

entries.name: FrameRate_Countdown
entries.description: dword: FrameRate_Update loads it with 32000 each frame and FrameRate_TimerTick decrements it to 0, so 32000 less its value is the timer ticks since the last frame.

entries.name: FrameRate_FrameCount
entries.description: dword: the frames FrameRate_Update has counted; FrameRate_GetFrameCount returns it.

entries.name: FrameRate_TicksPerSecond
entries.description: dword: 1000000 / Math_Q14Multiply(word +4 of the structure 000bdd0c points to, 0x35a1), set by FrameRate_Update's first call, which it also marks as done.

entries.name: MechMods_Present
entries.description: byte: bit n-1 set when MECMODn.DYN opened, written by MechMods_Probe. No reader found by a search of the disassembly for the address.

entries.name: Mono_Screen
entries.description: 2 bytes, built by MonoScreen_Ctor at startup: +0 is 1 when Crtc_DetectDualDisplay found both adapters, +1 is 1. Mono_Clear, Mono_WriteChar, Mono_WriteText, Mono_Printf, Mono_PrintScreen and Mono_ShowCursor do their work only while the two bytes share a set bit.

entries.name: g_ModelToView
entries.description: The current model-to-view transform (0x20 bytes), built by Raster_SetModelTransform. ES2's g_ModelToView (DBSIM 006c6038).

entries.name: g_ViewToModel
entries.description: The inverse of g_ModelToView, built by Raster_SetModelTransform. ES2's g_ViewToModel (DBSIM 006c6058).

entries.name: Transform_Identity
entries.description: The identity transform Raster_SetModelTransform and Raster_SetViewTransform install for a null pointer. ES2's DBSIM 006c6080.

entries.name: g_EyeInModelSpace
entries.description: The viewpoint in the current model's space (three ints): the origin through g_ViewToModel, written by Raster_SetModelTransform. ES2's g_EyeInModelSpace (DBSIM 006c60a0).

entries.name: Raster_ProjectionCentre
entries.description: The projection centre, two int32: the camera's clip rect's top-left less its render context's +0x220 pair (Raster_InstallViewProjection). ES2's DBSIM 006c60b8.

entries.name: Raster_ViewClipRect
entries.description: The installed camera's clip rect, four int32 copied from its render context's +0x210..+0x21c by Raster_InstallViewProjection. ES2's DBSIM 006c60c0.

entries.name: PolyFill_LineBrush
entries.description: The poly renderers' line brush: its mode at +0 and PolyFill_LineColour (000b5efc) at +4. Light_ResetSystem (000632ec) zeroes the mode. ES2's PolyFill_LineBrush (DBSIM 006c60d0).

entries.name: PolyFill_LineColour
entries.description: The polygon renderers' line colour; PolyFill_Fill and PolyFill_FillThenOutline draw an outline in it when it differs from the brush colour. ES2's DBSIM 006c60d4.

entries.name: PolyFill_FillBrush
entries.description: The polygon renderers' fill brush: +0 the mode, +4 the colour (000b5f04). ES2's DBSIM PolyFill_FillBrush (006c60d8).

entries.name: Poly_VertexCount
entries.description: The current polygon's vertex count (uint16), the start of the polygon scratch block, whose fields keep ES2's offsets from DBSIM 006c6968.

entries.name: Poly_IndexOffset
entries.description: The current polygon's offset into Poly_IndexList (uint16). ES2's DBSIM 006c696a.

entries.name: Poly_ShortPoints
entries.description: Pointer to the shape's int16 point triples, which Poly_ProjectShapeVertices projects. ES2's DBSIM 006c696c.

entries.name: Poly_IntPoints
entries.description: Pointer to the int32 point triples Poly_ProjectIndexedVertices and Poly_ProjectViewVertices project. ES2's DBSIM 006c6970.

entries.name: Poly_IndexList
entries.description: Pointer to the vertex-index list, uint16 point numbers. ES2's DBSIM 006c6976.

entries.name: Poly_PointState
entries.description: One byte per point, 1000: 0 not yet seen, 1 behind the near plane, 2 projected. ES2's DBSIM 006c697e.

entries.name: Poly_ViewCache
entries.description: 1000 int32 {x, y, z} view-space points; the projectors store each vertex's transformed point here and the near-plane clips interpolate from it. ES2's DBSIM Poly_ViewCache (006c6d66).

entries.name: Poly_ScreenCache
entries.description: 1000 int32 {x, y} screen points, each projected vertex's, copied for a point marked 2. ES2's DBSIM Poly_ScreenCache (006c9c46).

entries.name: Poly_ScreenPoints
entries.description: The ring to fill: 32 int32 {x, y} screen points, count at Poly_ScreenCount. ES2's DBSIM Poly_ScreenPoints (006cbb86).

entries.name: Poly_ScreenCount
entries.description: The ring's point count (uint16), set by the projectors and the near-plane clips. ES2's DBSIM 006cbc86.

entries.name: g_BaseTypeTable
entries.description: Pointer to the 0x3e-byte structure type records Base_LoadResources (000046ac) builds and reads dat\bases into; the count is the int16 at 000bc188.

entries.name: g_ExplosionTypeTable
entries.description: Pointer to dat\explos's 0x2c-byte rows, read by Explosion_LoadResources (00005764); the count is the int16 at 000bc1b4. ES2's g_ExplosionTypeTable, of 0x28-byte rows.

entries.name: g_ExplosionShapes
entries.description: Pointer to dts\explos's root array, loaded by Explosion_LoadResources (00005764). ES2's g_ExplosionShapes.

entries.name: g_BulletTypeTable
entries.description: Pointer to dat\bullets's 10-byte records, read by Bullet_LoadResources (00007bb0); the count is the int16 at 000bc1fa.

entries.name: GunLayout_Table
entries.description: Pointer to the gun-layout table of 6-byte {int16 count, record array} entries, GunLayout_Count (000bc2c0) long; GunLayout_AllocTable (0000c1b8) allocates it and GunLayout_GetBySlot (0000c18c) indexes it. ES2's GunLayout_Table (DBSIM 004a9968).

entries.name: GunLayout_Count
entries.description: int16 entry count of GunLayout_Table (000bc2bc); GunLayout_Reserve (0000c1a0) adds to it. ES2's GunLayout_Count (DBSIM 004a996c).

entries.name: WeaponMountTemplate_Table
entries.description: Pointer to the 17 0x58-byte mount templates Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48) builds with __vec_new and WeaponMountTemplate_Ctor (0000c0b4); WeaponMountTemplate_GetByWeaponId (0000c178) indexes it. ES2's WeaponMountTemplate_Table (DBSIM 004a9970).

entries.name: WeaponMountTemplate_Count
entries.description: int16 count of WeaponMountTemplate_Table (000bc2c2), which Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48) sets to 0x11, where ES2's reads it from the file. ES2's WeaponMountTemplate_Count (DBSIM 004a9974).

entries.name: WeaponModels_Mechwpn2Roots
entries.description: The shape roots Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48) loads from dts\mechwpn2 (dts\mwpn2b in low memory) with Shape_LoadAllRoots, WeaponModels_Mechwpn2RootCount (000bc2cc) of them. A search of the disassembly dump for the address finds the loader's push and read and one read, at 0000ba81, in WeaponMount_Destroy (0000b968).

entries.name: WeaponModels_Mechwpn2RootCount
entries.description: int16 count of WeaponModels_Mechwpn2Roots (000bc2c8), stored by Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48).

entries.name: ProjDat_RecordTable
entries.description: Pointer to the 19 0x24-byte projectile records Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48) reads from the end of dat\weapons. ES2's ProjDat_RecordTable, read from dat\proj.

entries.name: WeaponModels_ShapeChunks
entries.description: Array of pointers to the raw dts\mechwpns chunks WeaponModels_LoadShapeChunks (0000bc60) reads, WeaponModels_ShapeChunkCount (000bc412) of them; it ends 0xa0 bytes on, where WeaponModels_ShapeChunkSizes (000bc372) starts, room for 40. ES2's is at DBSIM 004a9988, 0xf0 bytes long.

entries.name: WeaponModels_ShapeChunkSizes
entries.description: Array of the byte lengths of the chunks in WeaponModels_ShapeChunks (000bc2d2), which WeaponModels_LoadShapeChunks (0000bc60) takes from ClassItem_TagTotalSize. ES2's is at DBSIM 004a9a78.

entries.name: WeaponModels_ShapeChunkCount
entries.description: int32 count of WeaponModels_ShapeChunks (000bc2d2), which WeaponModels_LoadShapeChunks (0000bc60) sets and WeaponModels_FreeShapeChunks (0000bd40) walks. ES2's is at DBSIM 004a9b68.

entries.name: LiveObjectList
entries.description: The live object list, a 0x10-byte record whose first dword, at this address, points at its array of object pointers: the int16 capacity at +4, the int16 count LiveObjectList_Count (000bc41c) at +6, and the pair cache at +8, whose record count, the int16 000bc420, lies in the zero-filled memory past the image's file bytes. DBSim_LoadScriptDat (0001d850) builds it with ObjectList_Init (0000db40), ObjectList_Add (0000db10) adds each object, and Sim_RaycastObjectList (0001f1d0), Sim_DetectionTick (0000e240) and the sensor functions walk it. ES2's maybe_GlobalLiveObjectList (DBSIM 004a9b7c), which has no pair cache.

entries.name: LiveObjectList_Count
entries.description: int16: the number of pointers in LiveObjectList (000bc416), the bound of Sim_RaycastObjectList's walk.

entries.name: Behaviour_DwellJitter
entries.description: int16: Behaviour_SetState (0000fdfc) adds 0xd to it and adds its low four bits to each new state's dwell countdown. ES2's Behaviour_DwellJitter (DBSIM 004a9bf4).

entries.name: PlayerMech
entries.description: Pointer to the player's machine: 00011050 passes its weapon mount manager +0x198 to WeaponMounts_HandleCommand (0000d4b4), and Mech_AiEnemySighted (0000e760) compares its group (+0x3f) and reads its contact bytes (+0xbc). ES2's PlayerMech (DBSIM 004a9c08).

entries.name: g_MechTypeCount
entries.description: int16: the number of chassis slots allocated, set to 0 by Mech_LoadResources and incremented by MechTypeSlot_Allocate; Mechs_InitAllTypes allocates this many records.

entries.name: g_MechTypeSlotIndex
entries.description: 16 bytes, one per chassis type: its slot, or 0xff for none. Mech_LoadResources fills it with 0xff, MechTypeSlot_Allocate writes it and MechTypeSlot_GetIndex reads it.

entries.name: g_MechTypeNames
entries.description: Pointer to the name table LoadNameList builds from nam\mechs, indexed by chassis type; MechType_InitOne takes a type's file name from it.

entries.name: g_MechTypeTable
entries.description: Pointer to the chassis records, 0x1c4 bytes per slot, that Mechs_InitAllTypes allocates and MechType_InitOne fills.

entries.name: g_MechTextureGroupSlots
entries.description: Four dwords, the banks dba\light, medium, heavy and enemy that Mech_LoadResources loads when g_LowMemory (000bda98) is 0; MechType_InitOne stores the one a chassis' texture group (record +0x96) picks at each root's +0x26. ES2's g_MechTextureGroupSlots (DBSIM 004a9df6) is seven 8-byte slots whose address is stored instead.

entries.name: MissionGroups
entries.description: Pointer to the 0x28-byte mission group records, their int16 count MissionGroups_Count (000bc47a) at +4: MissionGroups_Allocate (0001d260) fills the pair, DBSim_SpawnMissionObjects (0001e638) builds one record per element through DBSim_BuildGroupRecord, which takes its address, and Actions_EvaluateTriggers (0001f87c) walks them.

entries.name: MissionGroups_Count
entries.description: int16: the number of records at MissionGroups (000bc476), stored by MissionGroups_Allocate at the array's +4.

entries.name: MissionActions_Count
entries.description: int16: the number of 16-byte actions at MissionActions (000bc496), block 5's count, the bound of Actions_EvaluateTriggers' walk.

entries.name: MissionActions
entries.description: Pointer to the 16-byte action records DBSim_LoadScriptDat (0001d850) builds from script.dat block 5; DBSim_SpawnMissionObjects (0001e638) resolves the objects' and groups' action refs to records here and Actions_EvaluateTriggers (0001f87c) walks them.

entries.name: Mission_StatusRaised
entries.description: int16: the mission status last raised, which Mission_PollStatus (0000f454) compares and stores and DBSim_SpawnMissionObjects (0001e638) sets to 0xffff. ES2's Mission_StatusForAlert (DBSIM 00413180) and Mission_PollStatus (DBSIM 004131ac) keep theirs at DBSIM 004a9ed0.

entries.name: ScriptDatHeader
entries.description: The 20-byte header DBSim_LoadScriptDat (0001d850) reads from data\script.dat: ten int16 header words, word 0 the theater, word 1 the zone, words 8 and 9 the world file's. Mission_WriteResults (0001d698) passes the dword at 000bc4a2, word 3, to Group_StatusLineIndex and Mission_TotalSalvage. ES2's ScriptDatHeader (DBSIM 004a9ed2).

entries.name: MissionModeFlag
entries.description: int16, script.dat header word 2 (ScriptDatHeader (000bc49c) + 4): WeaponMounts_ArbitrateEnergy (0000cc2c) and WeaponMounts_FireTrigger (0000d2bc) test it for 0 beside UnlimitedAmmoFlag (000bc4a6) for 1. ES2's MissionModeFlag (DBSIM 004a9ed6).

entries.name: UnlimitedAmmoFlag
entries.description: int16, script.dat header word 5 (ScriptDatHeader (000bc49c) + 0xa): with MissionModeFlag (000bc4a0) at 0 and this at 1, WeaponMounts_ArbitrateEnergy (0000cc2c) returns the budget it was given and WeaponMounts_FireTrigger (0000d2bc) passes a free-shot flag of 1. ES2's UnlimitedAmmoFlag (DBSIM 004a9edc).

entries.name: MissionAlertArmed
entries.description: Byte: set by Mission_PollStatus (0000f454) the first time a status worth raising appears, when it loads MissionAlertTimer_Count (000af7a1) with 10000. ES2's MissionAlertArmed (DBSIM 004a9eec).

entries.name: Salvage_PairCount
entries.description: int16: the number of salvage pairs at Salvage_Pairs (000bc4b4), which Mission_WriteResults (0001d698) writes to data\results.dat ahead of them.

entries.name: Salvage_Pairs
entries.description: Pointer to the salvage pairs, two int16 each, that Mission_WriteResults (0001d698) writes to data\results.dat; Mech_SalvageValue (00014034) passes Salvage_QueueWeapon a pair for each surviving hardpoint of a wreck.

entries.name: MissionVars
entries.description: The 100 int16 campaign flags, 200 bytes, that DBSim_LoadScriptDat (0001d850) reads from data\mission.var, zeroing flag 7 (000bc4c6), and Mission_WriteResults (0001d698) writes back. Action_Activate (0001cc5c) and Group_ReportIfAllOutOfAction (0001d524) write a flag by an operation; Mission_WriteResults adds 25000 per unit of flag 7 to the salvage award. ES2's counters at DBSIM 004a9ef4 are 1,000.

entries.name: Zone_TheaterShapeRoots
entries.description: Pointer to the array of root shapes Shape_LoadAllRoots loads from the theater's dgs\<name> in Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238); a zone's 20-byte records index it. Null after a load with a negative zone.

entries.name: Zone_ShapeObjects
entries.description: Pointer to the array of Zone_ShapeCount (000bc588) object pointers Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238) builds, one 0x3f-byte object (TS_OBJ and a pointer at +0x3b, vptr 000924be) per zone record. Null after a load with a negative zone; a load with a count of 0 leaves it as it was.

entries.name: Zone_ShapeCount
entries.description: int16: the zone file's record count (its word at +2), the number of objects at Zone_ShapeObjects (000bc584). Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238) reads it, or sets 0 for a negative zone.

entries.name: Zone_TheaterShapeRecords
entries.description: Pointer to the theater's 24-byte shape records, one per root shape, read from dat\<name> by Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238) into a __vec_new array of TheaterShapeRecord_ElementCtor (000204d8) elements. A zone object's +0x3b points at its shape's record unless that record's int32 at +8 is negative.

entries.name: ObjList_Objects
entries.description: Pointer to the object list's 512 object pointers (0x800 bytes from ObjList_Init (00020c2c)), which ObjList_Add (00020d5c) fills; the count is ObjList_Count (00092558).

entries.name: ObjList_ZoneShapeCount
entries.description: int16: the number of zone shapes at the head of ObjList_Objects (000bc58e), stored once the mission start has added them; ObjList_RebuildFrame (00020de0) resets ObjList_Count (00092558) to it, and ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) gives the objects below it their dividing line.

entries.name: ObjList_Entries
entries.description: Pointer to the 512 draw entries of 0x36 bytes ObjList_Init (00020c2c) builds with ObjListEntry_Ctor (00020c80), which ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) fills each frame.

entries.name: ObjList_DrawList
entries.description: Pointer to 512 draw-entry pointers (0x800 bytes from ObjList_Init (00020c2c)): the entries ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) keeps for ObjList_SortAndDraw (00021d04).

entries.name: CockpitViewManagerPublished
entries.description: The cockpit view manager, stored by CockpitViewManager_Publish and returned by CockpitViewManager_Published. Widget_DrawToCockpit tests its byte +0x18. ES2's CockpitViewManagerPublished (DBSIM 004cfa20).

entries.name: WorldShades_TypeTable
entries.description: Pointer to the 5-byte records {byte count, pointer to count two-byte pairs} World_LoadShades (00025bc8) reads from dat\shades, the record count byte at 000bc5c4. ES2's WorldShades_TypeTable (DBSIM 004cfd64).

entries.name: WorldShades_DistanceOffsets
entries.description: Two int32, 000bc5c6 and 000bc5ca, read from the world file after its two counts by World_LoadTheater (000251c4). ES2's WorldShades_DistanceOffsets (DBSIM 004cfd6c).

entries.name: PaletteCycle_Slots
entries.description: Five pointers to cycle records {int16 first, int16 count, int16 delay}, filled by PaletteCycle_Register (000281cc), emptied by PaletteCycle_Unregister (00028228) and zeroed by Palette_LoadResources (00027e10).

entries.name: PaletteCycle_DueTimes
entries.description: Five int32 clock values, each slot's next step in Palette_CycleAnimatedRanges (00028260).

entries.name: PaletteCycle_Offsets
entries.description: Five int16 offsets into each slot's range, advanced by Palette_CycleAnimatedRanges (00028260) and zeroed by PaletteCycle_Register (000281cc).

entries.name: PaletteFade_From
entries.description: The palette the cross fade starts from, stored by Palette_BeginCrossFade (00028528); Palette_StepCrossFade (000287a8) copies its entries in modes 1 and 2.

entries.name: PaletteFade_FirstEntry
entries.description: int16: the first palette entry Palette_StepCrossFade (000287a8) writes. A grep of the disassembly by address finds its five reads, all in Palette_StepCrossFade, and no store.

entries.name: PaletteFade_EntryCount
entries.description: int16: the number of entries the cross fade writes, the palette's +4 that Palette_BeginCrossFade (00028528) read.

entries.name: PaletteFade_Duration
entries.description: int32: the cross fade's length in clock counts, stored by Palette_BeginCrossFade (00028528).

entries.name: PaletteFade_DeltaRed
entries.description: 256 int16: each entry's red delta in 8.8 per clock count, from Palette_BeginCrossFade (00028528).

entries.name: PaletteFade_DeltaGreen
entries.description: 256 int16: each entry's green delta, as PaletteFade_DeltaRed (000bc614).

entries.name: PaletteFade_DeltaBlue
entries.description: 256 int16: each entry's blue delta, as PaletteFade_DeltaRed (000bc614).

entries.name: PaletteFade_Mode
entries.description: int16: 0 to fade in from black, 1 to fade out to black, 2 between two palettes; set by Palette_BeginCrossFade (00028528), read by Palette_StepCrossFade (000287a8).

entries.name: g_SquadmateMachines
entries.description: Three machine pointers, the player's squadmates by slot: zeroed by ColorSchemePanels_LoadAll (0002aecc), filled by Cockpit_LoadSquadmatePilots (0002b308), indexed by Squad_SendOrderToSlot (0002b3e8) and Squad_CallsignOf (0002b46c). ES2's g_SquadmateMachines (DBSIM 004d044c).

entries.name: PilotMessageIndex
entries.description: Three 0x183-byte indexes, one per squadmate slot, of 9-byte slots {dword text, byte count, dword attributes} at id * 9, filled from PilotStringTables (000b0e14) by SystemMessages_Index (0002f1ec). ES2's at DBSIM 004d04e8.

entries.name: CommandMessageIndex
entries.description: The index of str\commandr.str, 9-byte slots at id * 9, which MessagePort_Post (0002ed94) reads for ids from 0x32 at 000bceea + id * 9.

entries.name: SystemMessageIndex
entries.description: The index of str\system.str, 9-byte slots at id * 9, which MessagePort_Post (0002ed94) reads for a record with no subject. ES2's at DBSIM 004d0b33.

entries.name: SquadOrderStrings
entries.description: 18 string pointers, STRINGS0.STR group 0, the squadmate orders, filled by SimStrings_LoadAll (0002fe84). es2_xref finds the address at 00035dea, 00035e97, 00035f0a, 0003f75f, 0003f7fa and 00040a04. ES2's group 0 array (DBSIM 004d132c).

entries.name: SquadOrderAttributes
entries.description: 18 dwords, the attribute entries of STRINGS0.STR group 0 (one attribute byte per order in the retail file), filled by SimStrings_LoadAll (0002fe84) beside SquadOrderStrings (000bd228). es2_xref finds the address beside each of SquadOrderStrings' references. ES2's group 0 attribute array (DBSIM 004d1374).

entries.name: SquadCallsignStrings
entries.description: Three string pointers, which Squad_CallsignOf (0002b46c) returns by squadmate slot. ES2's SquadCallsignStrings (DBSIM 004d1424).

entries.name: g_LowMemory
entries.description: int16: set to 1 at 000595b1 in Sim_Main (00059350) when the heap Mem_InitHeap (00001524) returns is under 0x3c45b0 bytes; a search of the disassembly dump for the address finds that store and 14 compares. When it is set Mech_LoadResources (000198f0) loads no texture banks and MechType_InitOne (00019cf0) skips record +0x48's count of shape roots.

entries.name: Raster_ViewTransformPtr
entries.description: Pointer to the installed view transform, written by Raster_SetViewTransform. ES2's DBSIM 006c6078.

entries.name: g_ModelTransformPtr
entries.description: Pointer to the installed model transform, the identity at Transform_Identity (000b5eb4) when null is installed; written by Raster_SetModelTransform. ES2's g_ModelTransformPtr (DBSIM 006c607c).

entries.name: Raster_FocalShift
entries.description: The installed camera's focal shift (+0x1a): the projection is (x << shift) / depth, and 0 selects the orthographic form. ES2's DBSIM 006c60ac.

entries.name: Raster_NearPlane
entries.description: The installed camera's near-plane depth (+0x1e). ES2's DBSIM 006c60b0.

entries.name: Raster_OrthoDivisor
entries.description: The installed camera's orthographic divisor (+0x22), set only when the focal shift is 0. ES2's DBSIM 006c60b4.

entries.name: Light_ActiveCount
entries.description: Number of entries in Light_ActiveList. ES2's DBSIM 006c612c.

entries.name: Light_ActiveList
entries.description: The active light list, ten light pointers, which the shade functions walk. ES2's DBSIM 006c6130.

entries.name: Light_ModelSpaceEnabled
entries.description: Byte: when set, Raster_SetModelTransform moves each registered light into the model's space and the save and restore carry the lights' copies. ES2's DBSIM 006cbc88.

entries.name: Bitmap_UseCallerScratch
entries.description: Flag Bitmap_Blit tests after drawing a packed bitmap: while it is 0 the blit deletes Bitmap_UnpackScratch. ES2's Bitmap_UseCallerScratch (DBSIM 006c5ff8).

entries.name: Bitmap_UnpackScratch
entries.description: The buffer a packed bitmap is unpacked into for drawing: Bitmap_Blit puts it in the bitmap's data pointer +0xe for the blit and deletes it afterwards unless Bitmap_UseCallerScratch is set. ES2's Bitmap_UnpackScratch (DBSIM 006c5ffc).
